**Bottom line: The American people deserve a seat at the negotiating table.** Unfortunately, all indications are that the Biden team is negotiating an even worse agreement behind closed doors.

That’s why Mike is holding Biden accountable by pledging to oppose any agreement that bypasses Congress—and the American people. name: Melanie D'Arrigo
subject: We must not let hate win
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Melanie Darrigo
body:
| | | Last week, a Long Island hate group sent at least one member of its group to the Manhasset School Board meeting.
This hate group member proceeded to take pictures of the inside of the school, which is a clear violation of safety protocols within our schools and then went on to attack the Manhasset LGBTQ+ community and denounce gender equity issues.
**As a mother, a NYS delegate to the National Organization for Women and a co-founder of an LGBTQIA+ non-profit, I am beyond horrified that a member of our community would go out of their way to bully and prey on the vulnerabilities of children.**
****Folks are allowed to have opinions, but when they involve hateful attacks on children and amplify hate, it is long past time to re-evaluate your agenda. [](https://u1584542.ct.sendgrid.net/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953xvsu9hCVaerzAxagfczWNtR7WNj0Vvrg4HKrNk9USOunoX-04ND2SQFX-pBY04xC_QCQDACTm8RVZGghS2VwycrwGirWxSyy-7rx7_pKPrOas4joCcCX4m7STNIxG8l148wes_RQ5S3FRWUnlrb0oxi_s--wL-9z4SuOQkhd6jDW04Fi0VutgjRL1Zmvkn-o8mwa-8VtCphfKz3FdM5xnl-24ghLzSnxyKgF3buMn2Kr2cYtw4yAtyW2fXsnA-fyoU4nG49lPw8aWZ4RHhiEGbAAemRy4LX6T5-YSXuzWPI5ouCrhjdHWwuh5JKJGOF42WhSFItK5APgb-utdv8uWhRIN5hlU2kUrGv4sBm41JKw/3jt/y5iiSnoWSq2sSsz0Obq89g/h0/gbYy7gvAqYD-YaCx9KDkeI-7bL8CEPeFYgKGtH1AWKM) Every child, every gender, every identity is equally valued and deserves to feel love and acceptance. There is no hierarchy over who deserves to be seen. We are a community of multi-generational families, single parent families, queer families, immigrant and bi-racial families all connected by the love of our community. We all belong here. **There are more of us working to create a moral and equitable world than there are those who are trying to dismantle inclusive communities. clean_body: | | | Last week, a Long Island hate group sent at least one member of its group to the Manhasset School Board meeting. This hate group member proceeded to take pictures of the inside of the school, which is a clear violation of safety protocols within our schools and then went on to attack the Manhasset LGBTQ+ community and denounce gender equity issues. As a mother, a NYS delegate to the National Organization for Women and a co-founder of an LGBTQIA+ non-profit, I am beyond horrified that a member of our community would go out of their way to bully and prey on the vulnerabilities of children. **Folks are allowed to have opinions, but when they involve hateful attacks on children and amplify hate, it is long past time to re-evaluate your agenda. Every child, every gender, every identity is equally valued and deserves to feel love and acceptance. There is no hierarchy over who deserves to be seen. We are a community of multi-generational families, single parent families, queer families, immigrant and bi-racial families all connected by the love of our community. We all belong here. There are more of us working to create a moral and equitable world than there are those who are trying to dismantle inclusive communities. We must not let hate win.** We must continue the good work of creating equity by combating their hate with love for our community and each other. I will forever stand with the LGBTQIA+ community. I will forever fight for gender equity and parity. And I will always fight to protect our children and create a world they deserve. name: Charles Booker
subject: I wish I was joking.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter,

You might have missed it, but last week in Kentucky, GOP legislators
considered a bill that would defund local communities and school districts
in order to pay for a tax cut on private planes.

I wish I was joking:

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/16662?refcode=em20220222-1594&amp%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=1594%2E346206%2EfW3P7s ][IMG]

Let me tell you why this is striking. It’s not just because it shows how
out of touch these lawmakers are (though it does do that very clearly).
It’s because this is yet another example of how poverty becomes a policy
choice.

Every time politicians decide to give tax breaks to their rich donors, the
rest of us pay for it.

We pay for it in overcrowded classrooms. We pay for it in broken axles
from the potholes in our roads. We pay for it in cuts to Medicaid, social
security, and food stamps. I am sick and tired of working people being
told to pull ourselves up by our bootstraps when we have no boots to begin
with.

Our elected leaders should be investing in solutions that we know would
lift millions out of poverty: fully funded public schools, affordable
prescription drugs, and a guaranteed universal basic income.

Ending poverty is also a policy choice. We just need leaders with the
conviction to do it. This is why I’m running for the Senate. And it’s why
I’m asking if you’d join me.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/16662?refcode=em20220222-1594&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=1594%2E346206%2EfW3P7s ]Please chip in $5 or whatever you can today to our
campaign, and help me replace Rand Paul in the Senate so we can end
poverty once and for all.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/16662?refcode=em20220222-1594&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=1594%2E346206%2EfW3P7s ]Contribute $5

Together, we can usher in the representation we deserve from our Senate.
But I can’t do this alone: [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/16662?refcode=em20220222-1594&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=1594%2E346206%2EfW3P7s ]If you’re with me, I hope you can chip
in $5 or anything you can right now to support our
grassroots-funded movement.

Together,

Charles

body:
This could harm so many people.
#
Derek,
Extremist Republican Senator Rick Scott, the chair of the National Republican Senatorial Committee, put together an 11-Point Plan for Republicans to enact if they flip the House and Senate this November. Yeahh... Ok.
Believe me when I say it is absolutely ridiculous. But that doesn’t mean we can discount its potential impact.
From naming a border wall after Donald Trump to declaring “there are two genders,” this so-called 11-Point Plan is going to be extremely harmful for so. many. people.
**This is why we need to do everything we can to flip this seat, Derek.** We can’t afford a future where Republicans get to enact their terrible policies.
**[Can you please make a donation today to help support our campaign so we can flip this seat and maintain our Democratic majority in the Senate?](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/44876?refcode=em20220222-4694&t=1&akid=4694%2E434096%2EkBXXvu)**

But that doesn’t mean it’s just going to happen. It means we need to be putting our all into this race each and every day if we’re going to pull out ahead in both the May primary *and* the November general election.

Earlier today, in response to President Vladimir Putin’s invasion into Ukrainian territory, President Biden announced a first wave of U.S. economic sanctions against Russia.
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42116683/331722610/396464211?refcode=em-logo&refcode2=aa635887-4894-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&contactdata=p6Qyx02/xKbX808P+OE92TDS4bvUWvKx4cEUKZjJ2wwB4X12Q5NtvWYhm39zOKcw&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODIzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYTYzNTg4Ny00ODk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dL8U0E9NnegfWyS6gTygFYS9J_Awb-vDiCQWNHWBKns=)
Friends -
Earlier today, in response to President Vladimir Putin’s invasion into Ukrainian territory, President Biden announced a first wave of U.S. economic sanctions against Russia. With nearly 190,000 Russian troops now encircling Ukraine, the stage has been set for a massive military action — making this the biggest security crisis Europe and the NATO alliance have faced since the end of the Cold War.
For weeks now the White House and our European allies have sought to prevent this conflict by engaging in intense direct diplomacy with Putin. But diplomacy has not succeeded to date. Yesterday Putin made it clear to the world that he is taking the first step in what would become a very bloody, costly, and extended conflict.
Over this past weekend I attended the Munich Security Conference to discuss the ongoing crisis. It was clear to me that our NATO allies and other partners are firmly united behind the mission of opposing Putin’s aggression and imposing punishing economic sanctions to raise the cost to Putin and his regime of his military action against the people of Ukraine. Together with our European allies, we must also provide the Ukrainian resistance with the defensive weapons they need to fight Russian occupation. And we must reinforce NATO frontline states.
The borders of Europe were transformed through use of force over 70 years ago and we cannot go back to that time. Putin is directly challenging the post-Cold War security architecture of Europe — and Ukraine is not the only country against which he has grievances.
By working closely and decisively with our allies and others in the international community, we must raise the costs to Putin of following the path of aggression -- and ensure that his decision to unleash unprovoked violence in the heart of Europe is remembered as an epic miscalculation.
To do any less would embolden others that may seek to use force to overthrow democratically elected governments and change their borders in violation of international law.
Thank you for reading.
Onwards,
Chris

subject: Mr. Biden, Build That Wall

body:
[](http://asg.vervemail9.com/ct/59632027:Jiex9xEpN:m:1:3103520637:7A98496E2EC28B2BECABDC043694FCEE:r "Headline") Peter, 2,000,000 illegal aliens invaded our country last year. That number will pale in comparison to this year if we don't address the crisis at the southern border. President Biden is solely to blame for this crisis. As a presidential candidate, he touted plans to end President Trump's successful border policies. And once sworn in, he followed through on those promises, ending construction of the border wall and the Remain in Mexico program, and reinstating catch-and-release policies. The consequences of a porous southern border aren't just disastrous for border communities, but for our entire nation. Huge gaps in the border wall serve as de facto ports of entry for illegal crossings; large groups crossing tie up Border Patrol resources; and drug and human traffickers easily slip onto our highways and into your local communities. Yet, under Joe Biden's failed leadership, there is no end in sight. But I won't stand for that... I'm Congressman Andy Biggs from Arizona and I serve as the Co-Chair of the House Border Security Caucus. **[Will you stand with me today and demand the Biden Administration secure our borders and protect America's sovereignty?](http://asg.vervemail9.com/ct/59632027:Jiex9xEpN:m:1:3103520637:7A98496E2EC28B2BECABDC043694FCEE:r "Will you stand with me today and demand the Biden Administration
secure our borders and protect America’s sovereignty?")** **Joe Biden has traded border security for border INSECURITY, leaving us in a state of chaos that he refuses to fix.** [](http://asg.vervemail9.com/ct/59632027:Jiex9xEpN:m:1:3103520637:7A98496E2EC28B2BECABDC043694FCEE:r "Border")Unlike the liberal elites who live in their Washington bubble, I visit the border regularly. I've personally seen HUNDREDS of illegal aliens pour through gaps in our border wall that Joe Biden refuses to finish building. In November alone, border agents reported a 140% spike in encounters at the southern border. Then December saw the highest month on record - 178,840 apprehensions. In Yuma, Arizona--and all along the border--our Border Patrol agents are overwhelmed. In a one-week span, more than 6,000 illegal aliens entered through Yuma, bringing the sector's three-month total to 22,000 encounters. **The time for rhetoric has ended. The time for action is now.** **[Can I count on your contribution of $250, $100, $50, $25 or whatever you can afford to help me lead the fight to secure our borders?](http://asg.vervemail9.com/ct/59632027:Jiex9xEpN:m:1:3103520637:7A98496E2EC28B2BECABDC043694FCEE:r "Can I count on your contribution of $250, $100, $50, $25 or
whatever you can afford to help me lead the fight to secure our borders?")** I am fighting tooth and nail to spur President Biden to finish building the border wall, to end catch-and-release policies, and enforce the laws on the books. **We can get the job done, but it takes commitment, principle, and leadership, all of which Joe Biden lacks.** I hope I can **[count on your support](http://asg.vervemail9.com/ct/59632027:Jiex9xEpN:m:1:3103520637:7A98496E2EC28B2BECABDC043694FCEE:r "count on your
support")** to force President Biden to secure the border and ensure the safety of American communities. For our security, [](http://asg.vervemail9.com/ct/59632027:Jiex9xEpN:m:1:3103520637:7A98496E2EC28B2BECABDC043694FCEE:r "Andy Biggs") Andy Biggs

clean_body: This is extremely important. Please see a note from one of our sponsors. If you would like to unsubscribe visit this Peter – There’s a reason I’m passionate about our national security. Our national security paves the way for every aspect of our lives – our economic security and prosperity depend on our foreign policy decisions. All of this is circular, Peter. Without national security, we have nothing. That’s the biggest lesson I learned since I joined the military 20 years ago. And it’s a lesson I take seriously. The only people that seem to understand the true cost of freedom and the need to protect our national security are other veterans. We’ve been to combat. We’ve seen what happens when career politicians make decisions that put our nation at risk. And it’s why I’m running for the U.S. Senate...because a soldier runs to the fight, and the fight is now in the U.S. Senate. That’s why I’m reaching out to you, Peter. My name is Marjorie K. Eastman. I’m a veteran, military wife, mother, and businesswoman – and I’m running to represent North Carolina in the U.S. Senate. When I look at the direction our country is heading in, I’m worried. I’m concerned about career politicians’ inability to govern and protect our freedoms. When I enlisted in the Army, I took an oath to protect and defend those freedoms. That’s what I’ve always done – and will continue to do in the U.S. Senate. I bring something unique to this race, Peter. I’m the only combat veteran and conservative outsider. I know what it means to go to war, to put your life on the line for your country. I’ve seen first-hand what freedom trulycosts – and that’s something that can’t be bought. In the days and weeks after 9/11, I was like so many other Americans. I felt compelled to serve my country, and I have – through 10 years of intelligence service and two deployments. When I returned home, I faced a personal battle: my son was diagnosed with cancer. I quickly transitioned back into mom mode. My husband and I prayed every day, and eventually, my son beat his diagnosis. I’ve stood by my husband and supported his military career while also working in the private and non-profit sector, all with their own unique challenges. All of these battles led me to this mission today. body:
An Opinion Piece By Mike Ortega | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42122737/331734274/938621104?refcode=fl_email_fr_20211230housingrights_TO_full_xx_hdr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU2NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNmFlMjg4MS1hODk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NI_PBnDyG34eQ9PHOAi-jT_X-c3pubZwSkgbf-841z8=)
---
Friends, Joe Biden was elected president to do two things: oust Donald Trump from the oval office, and make up for years of not fighting for working families. This past year, with Bernie Sanders at the helm of the Senate budget committee, the Democrats came out swinging and introduced a bill. It included lowering prices of hundreds of prescription drugs, as well as 12 weeks of paid family and medical leave for all Americans. They were going to pass this through a process which would require almost every vote in the slim Democratic majority. The Democrats seemed to finally be playing ball with the Republicans. They gave them a taste of their own medicine by tying this bill, called the American Jobs & Families Plan (AJFP) to another bill focused on infrastructure - which the GOP wanted to pass. Then came the barrage of bad-faith arguments about the negative effects that the AJFP would have. One argument was coming from Lou Correa, my representative here in California’s 46th congressional district. He was no longer supporting lowering prescription drug prices at the same level that he voted for in 2019, when Trump was president. This spring, Lou helped write [a letter](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42122738/331734298/1361308896?id=00000179-5df9-d7df-a37d-fffb8de30000&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU2NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNmFlMjg4MS1hODk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NI_PBnDyG34eQ9PHOAi-jT_X-c3pubZwSkgbf-841z8=&emci=1e28cbe1-2d94-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=c6ae2881-a894-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=12523946) to Democratic leadership arguing that if they lowered the prices of too many drugs, they would hurt the pharmaceutical industry's ability to create new ones. He ignored the Congressional Budget Office’s conclusion that this was[ “simply not true”](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42122739/331734319/-1971380973?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU2NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNmFlMjg4MS1hODk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NI_PBnDyG34eQ9PHOAi-jT_X-c3pubZwSkgbf-841z8=&emci=1e28cbe1-2d94-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=c6ae2881-a894-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=12523946), as well as their reporting that the provision would create over[ $700 billion](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42122740/331734345/-1707611028?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU2NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNmFlMjg4MS1hODk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NI_PBnDyG34eQ9PHOAi-jT_X-c3pubZwSkgbf-841z8=&emci=1e28cbe1-2d94-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=c6ae2881-a894-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=12523946) in budget savings. With a handful of other Democrats, Correa threw his weight behind[ an alternative bill. This new bill covered a fraction of the drugs included in the original bill.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42122741/331734377/1799629331?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU2NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNmFlMjg4MS1hODk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NI_PBnDyG34eQ9PHOAi-jT_X-c3pubZwSkgbf-841z8=&emci=1e28cbe1-2d94-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=c6ae2881-a894-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=12523946) In the end, these Democrats held out and got their way. This failure is laid at the feet of Democrats like Lou Correa and Kyrsten Sinema. They[ take tens of thousands of dollars](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42122743/331734408/-870848495?cat=H04&catlong=Pharmaceuticals%2FHealth+Products&cid=N00037260&cycle=2022&seclong=Health§or=H&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU2NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNmFlMjg4MS1hODk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NI_PBnDyG34eQ9PHOAi-jT_X-c3pubZwSkgbf-841z8=&emci=1e28cbe1-2d94-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=c6ae2881-a894-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=12523946) from pharmaceutical corporations. The industry goes further and funds front-groups that [run ads](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42122745/331734432/1116185716?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU2NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNmFlMjg4MS1hODk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NI_PBnDyG34eQ9PHOAi-jT_X-c3pubZwSkgbf-841z8=&emci=1e28cbe1-2d94-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=c6ae2881-a894-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=12523946) in their districts as a 'thank you'. That’s the handshake that we’re used to now - profits for corporations at the expense of working families. Lou Correa helped destroy a bill that[ 91% of voters](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42122757/331734459/1898539911?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU2NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNmFlMjg4MS1hODk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NI_PBnDyG34eQ9PHOAi-jT_X-c3pubZwSkgbf-841z8=&emci=1e28cbe1-2d94-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=c6ae2881-a894-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=12523946#Registered%20Voters'%20Support%20For%20Allowing%20Medicare%20to%20Negotiate%20Lower%20Prescription%20Drug%20Prices:house:Registered%20Voters:646) here in CA-46 support, and it would have saved[ 94,000 lives every year](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42122768/331734487/-870848495?cat=H04&catlong=Pharmaceuticals%2FHealth+Products&cid=N00037260&cycle=2022&seclong=Health§or=H&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU2NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNmFlMjg4MS1hODk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NI_PBnDyG34eQ9PHOAi-jT_X-c3pubZwSkgbf-841z8=&emci=1e28cbe1-2d94-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=c6ae2881-a894-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=12523946) nationwide. Its potential savings would have helped fund other programs in the AJFP, like paid family and medical leave. Not only are these tradeoffs unsustainable, they are immoral. Ultimately, it was a Senator from West Virginia who had the power to deliver the ultimate prize for corporate donors and lobbyists - killing the bill. As one Representative out of 435, Lou Correa did not have that option - but he did what he could to strip away meaningful change for working families. I believe that he must not be given another chance. I come from humble beginnings. I watched my mother ration her insulin throughout my life. I got a job while I was going to college to help pay for her medicines and treatments so we could both rest at night. These are the kinds of choices working people have to make every day to combat the greed of pharmaceutical companies. Today, I am fortunate enough to take up the fight against this status quo. I am running to unseat Lou Correa in 2022. The choices our leaders make here matter to working families across the nation. When we get a seat at the table, we need to be doing everything we can to help working people provide basic needs. We can’t elect people like Lou who will [fight against ending surprise billing](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42122776/331734509/186496088?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU2NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNmFlMjg4MS1hODk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NI_PBnDyG34eQ9PHOAi-jT_X-c3pubZwSkgbf-841z8=&emci=1e28cbe1-2d94-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=c6ae2881-a894-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=12523946). When confronted with his record, he has called all of the above evidence “disinformation” to my face. My campaign refuses corporate money. We’re going to work with those in Congress that focus on delivering material gains for working people, not corporations. The people of our district deserve a Congressperson who will wake up everyday ready to fight for higher wages, affordable housing, better education, and Medicare for All. In a district where Bernie Sanders won 54% of the vote in the 2020 presidential primary, besting the runner-up by almost 34 points - our people are ready for change. [Chip in to our campaign today — our end-of-month grassroots fundraising goal is in one week, and we’re $2,252 away from hitting our goal! Anything helps.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42122790/331734535/-1631718953?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU2NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNmFlMjg4MS1hODk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NI_PBnDyG34eQ9PHOAi-jT_X-c3pubZwSkgbf-841z8=) | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

[](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001b8ThRfannzPD7a_p-gwUaeITllkapUlNDqXRUw91YvAbqhoPcwYgllrdBO0X79VZhh169G6Wh8eyLNQ8aWHWp7jOGzi72HhC88Mr8SRlPIhcsrMmuRbCx5Gb5Gp2-RsWOSubKeEt6tVodhemShXfnkI0HKnYc8NuTmbWmpF52xBT0Oh129MdzZtZ1UWXakONiLSVAvKOLOEvI73OiZ6onv7ZZ6kizujr7ZVwjisGOI0L2-gUePrXJQ==&c=JWxcS_BnKqPmWJjgIca1PZsnH9CVS9EJYeubWxViiQNTCrteukjaNA==&ch=hE1VC49iubtcJ56yeTiBbo5051NZnJV719mMe4cLvGlono4IqB4SVw==)
---
For over two years now, Houston students have been forced to wear a mask in school. As the COVID-19 survival rate for American children is 99.9%, masks are completely unnecessary. They are also disruptive to learning and communicating in classrooms and have a negative, psychological impact. They are dehumanizing and inhibit the ability to see and process non-verbal communication. This mandate is abusive, and I was more than happy to protest it with other Texans.
I'm also proud to be one of two TX38 congressional candidates on the Republican ballot who signed the Texans for Vaccine Choice Protection Pledge, promising the citizens of the State of Texas that I will "vigorously work to prohibit all vaccine mandates in Texas, including those imposed by both public and private businesses, and I support a special session to do so immediately."
---
---
The issue of forced vaccination is a personal one as it has affected those close to me. The coercive effort by both the Biden Administration and complicit corporations to increase vaccination numbers is immoral and repugnant. The lengths through which those close to me have had to go to state, prove, and defend their religious reasons for not complying with vaccine mandates should be considered unlawful. Vaccination is a decision to be made by the individual. I have and will always defend vaccine choice.
---
---
Finally, it gave me immense pleasure to join other congressional candidates such as Robby Starbuck, Christian Collins, Bo Hines, and Andrew McCarthy in signing the Michael Knowles Federal Public Health Protection Pledge. By signing it, I have given my total commitment to subpoena Anthony Fauci for an investigation into his corrupt activities and the lies he's told to both Congress and to the American people throughout the COVID-19 pandemic. I have also committed to sponsoring and voting for legislation that will reduce his salary to ZERO dollars. His actions towards Americans have been criminal. He will be held accountable.
---
My promise to you has been to always fight for your freedoms. Whether it is by doing so now, in TX38 and in our broader Houston community, or in the future as your congressman in Washington, I will stand by that promise.
It will be my honor to do so.
---
---

body:

[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zm7620meigraag894dihfro4kbil4b9s3rcv7i10_rp22sh2s8i66ob5cdh62o72c9h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf6s9jmdij5c3iccr38ohi61qbepdic1jmep1h6hj3csbks9jj6p316dj30s76msrt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coqm9ddjcupb8phmc2pm2ptgmlin49fg)

---
| |
Dear Friend, While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew the giant, they likely don’t know his full story—especially the tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about fathers and sons.

King David’s momentous story provides profound insights into many of life’s most important questions, including: What are my responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way to lead others?

Taught by Hillsdale College Professor of English Justin Jackson, **“The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King”** examines the Old Testament books of First and Second Samuel. This eight-lesson course explores David’s character and the consequences of his choices on his family and the people of Israel.
---
| | **This is why we’ve produced our online course, “The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King,” which is now available on DVD. And you can reserve your copy using this secure link:**

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/david-story-dvd](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2po6vhio85skk11m3ifdpnc4dcrqsp0aimg5o1o_rp22sh2s8i66ob5cdh62o72c9h2bs)** By viewing the course, you’ll learn more about the nature of God, family, leadership, sin, and repentance; in short, you’ll learn more about what truly matters in life. **I hope you’ll reserve your DVD today and share its abiding lessons with your family and friends. The DVD is perfect for a Bible study or homeschool curriculum.**
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zs25dkeolrk2jcetsn2gsht9v3pfucm2g085t208_rp22sh2s8i66ob5cdh62o72c9h2bs)
---
| | Let’s learn what truly matters in life by studying **“The David Story.”**

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09

Hillsdale College

Peter: It's time to retire Liz Cheney.
The RNC's decision to censure Cheney last week was largely symbolic. What we really need is to remove her from Congress by replacing her with a true conservative.
**[You can help us do that today by supporting Harriet Hageman for Congress in Wyoming.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59638251:6IreQFENC:m:1:3253819041:1704BF5316782595B36FEE72E6812D35:r)**
Cheney is the media's favorite Republican because she joined with Nancy Pelosi to attack and impeach Donald Trump. But long before she betrayed her president, she betrayed her state and her party.
Cheney has had a weak voting record during her entire congressional career. She sees her job as helping Democrats pass legislation, rather than fighting them to save America. She is a classic RINO whose loyalty is to the Swamp, not the people she serves.
Wyoming only gets one member of Congress and they deserve someone who shares and fights for their values. That's why Harriet Hageman is challenging an incumbent despite all Cheney's power and connections.
**[Please support Harriet Hageman with a generous contribution of any amount up to $5,800 today.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59638251:6IreQFENC:m:1:3253819041:1704BF5316782595B36FEE72E6812D35:r)**
House Freedom Fund will pay all processing fees and transfer 100% of your donation directly to the Hageman campaign.
_The stakes are too high today to sit on the sidelines._
Harriet is the leader Wyoming has been waiting for. For the last 20 years, she has been fighting back against federal agencies that threaten our rights with overbearing regulations. As an attorney, she...
▶︎ Fought Bill Clinton's attempt to block access to one-third of Wyoming's National Forest Lands;
▶︎ Stopped the EPA's efforts to take control of irrigation infrastructure and operations, and
▶︎ Blocked the USDA from forcing livestock producers to use radio-frequency eartags and register ranches with the federal government.
Liz Cheney ducks fights - or joins the other side! Harriet has been fighting and winning conservative victories for decades.
**Harriet is exactly what Washington needs more of and exactly who we need fighting for all of us. **
The DC establishment will do everything it can to protect Cheney. Only a national grassroots effort will stop her. We can do it, but we need everyone to pitch in.
[**Please join the fight for America's future by supporting Harriet Hageman today!**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59638251:6IreQFENC:m:1:3253819041:1704BF5316782595B36FEE72E6812D35:r)
Liz Cheney comes from a Washington Establishment dynasty. She will raise millions from corporate dollars, and from Democrats too. Harriet's only support is us.
_Can we count on your help for Harriet 's campaign? We need her - and in this fight, she needs us!_
[**Harriet Hageman has answered the call. Please do the same for her by making a contribution today.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59638251:6IreQFENC:m:1:3253819041:1704BF5316782595B36FEE72E6812D35:r)
Thank you for fighting for conservative leadership in Washington and for being willing to help retire liberal Republicans like Liz Cheney. Sincerely,

| | Friend, This week marks the end of Black History Month, a month that recognizes the significant contributions Black people and communities have made to American history. During Black History Month and beyond, Fair Fight Action strives to lift up communities of color, and to combat efforts to disempower and disenfranchise voters. As we close out Black History Month, we want to highlight some of the organizations that undertake critical work like ours. These organizations were created to serve, represent and protect the rights of Black people in Georgia. Please consider celebrating the end of Black History Month by supporting one or more of these organizations and making a donation today. [Black Voters Matter Fund](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42129235/331761117/-495437294?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZWFjZDIxMS1iNTk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6kfxVvkSgP6k1c9TMy3qMeN1OSvoZohEKki31Cx0qLQ=&emci=c92d8bdb-9f94-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=2eacd211-b594-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=1037277) \- The goal of Black Voters Matter Fund is to increase power in marginalized, predominantly Black communities. Effective voting allows a community to determine its own destiny. [The Coalition for the People’s Agenda](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42129236/331761118/755459924?cmd=_s-xclick&hosted_button_id=LVMAHSTGDQDN2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZWFjZDIxMS1iNTk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6kfxVvkSgP6k1c9TMy3qMeN1OSvoZohEKki31Cx0qLQ=&emci=c92d8bdb-9f94-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=2eacd211-b594-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=1037277) \- The Georgia Coalition for the People’s Agenda is an umbrella organization of human rights, civil rights, labor, women’s, youth, and peace and justice groups which advocate for voting rights protection, elimination of barriers to the ballot box, criminal justice reform, quality education, affordable housing, economic development and equal participation in the political process for Georgians of color and underrepresented communities. [Southern Center for Human Rights](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42129238/331761120/1454993783?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZWFjZDIxMS1iNTk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6kfxVvkSgP6k1c9TMy3qMeN1OSvoZohEKki31Cx0qLQ=&emci=c92d8bdb-9f94-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=2eacd211-b594-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=1037277) \- The Southern Center for Human Rights is a non-profit public interest law firm dedicated to enforcing the civil and human rights of people in the criminal justice system in the South. [SisterSong](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42129239/331761121/-1852809575?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZWFjZDIxMS1iNTk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6kfxVvkSgP6k1c9TMy3qMeN1OSvoZohEKki31Cx0qLQ=&emci=c92d8bdb-9f94-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=2eacd211-b594-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=1037277) \- The SisterSong Women of Color Reproductive Justice Collective, also known as SisterSong, is a national activist organization with roots in Georgia dedicated to reproductive justice for women of color. NOW , Mitch McConnell's committee is launching the first of many attack ads to defeat me – and I'm falling dangerously short of my $50,000 grassroots fundraising goal. Stacey Abrams "flipped" Georgia for Joe Biden.

And now she's running for Governor of the Peach State.
But like we've said over and over...Stacey Abrams is on a mission for a TOTAL TAKEOVER.
Have you checked the shortlist recently for SCOTUS? You know, the Highest Court in the land that makes historic decisions with far reaching consequences.
New York Post: "Judge Leslie Abrams Gardner, 47, the sister of two-time Democratic gubernatorial candidate Stacey Abrams, and California Supreme Court Justice Leondra Kruger, 45, are also believed to be in contention."
That's right. Stacey Abrams is trying to get her sister on the High Court to help advance her radical, un-American agenda. It's all part of the plan!
We get it...you feel like Stacey and the radical left are TOO POWERFUL to be stopped...but that's not true.
We rallied the troops and delivered a sizable win for the good guys in 2018. With your help, we can do it again in 2022.
Right now, our goal at Stop Stacey is simple: Get as many grassroots conservatives in Georgia - and around the country - to join our ranks.
Then, as they election approaches, we will mobilize that army and drive historic turnout at the ballot box.

body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42137611/331782190/-2037180865?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MjcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNzNiMzY3NS1iZDk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CuqzavdKID52YRlOdYZi_3U305xfF_F7ra-obvZCPOw=&emci=55c22742-3694-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=f73b3675-bd94-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=12898431)

Friend,
I never planned to run for office. But when I got involved at my daughter's school I realized how badly our schools and our teachers needed help.
That help was not coming from Republicans in the State Legislature, so I decided to get in the fight. In my time advocating as a parent and a legislator, I never heard anyone call teachers terrorists. But that was then.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42137612/331782191/416963966?refcode=X_022322_TeachersAreTerrorists&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MjcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNzNiMzY3NS1iZDk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CuqzavdKID52YRlOdYZi_3U305xfF_F7ra-obvZCPOw=)
---
**Teachers are not terrorists - they are heroes.**
And they will continue to be heroes despite the legislature's attempt to sabotage our public schools and educators _by voting_ _against a a bill that would lift the school spending cap that would have prevented the disbursement of nearly $1.2 billion already in school budgets._
Thanks to strong bipartisan support, the bill passed -- despite the efforts of Ugenti-Rita and her allies. One of whom was (you guessed it) my opponent, Sen. Kelly Townsend. Townsend, who was in DC and missed the vote, quickly took to Twitter to declare she would have voted with Ugenti-Rita to defund our schools had she known the vote was taking place.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42137613/331782192/416963966?refcode=X_022322_TeachersAreTerrorists&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MjcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNzNiMzY3NS1iZDk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CuqzavdKID52YRlOdYZi_3U305xfF_F7ra-obvZCPOw=)
---
**But we cannot simply roll our eyes and groan. We cannot allow the far-right to normalize this type of hateful rhetoric, and we certainly cannot afford to give people like Kelly Townsend a promotion.**
Look, I don't know what she was doing in DC that caused her to miss the vote, but it wouldn't shock me if she was there to raise money from special interest groups, wealthy corporations, and increasingly powerful alt-right organizations.
Which is why I need you to help fight back against the radical right by making a contribution to our campaign today. [**Whether it's $5, $25, or $500, every dollar helps keep this seat out of the hands of the far-right ideologues who want to starve our schools and demonize our teachers.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42137614/331782193/416963966?refcode=X_022322_TeachersAreTerrorists&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MjcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNzNiMzY3NS1iZDk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CuqzavdKID52YRlOdYZi_3U305xfF_F7ra-obvZCPOw=)
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42137615/331782194/416963966?refcode=X_022322_TeachersAreTerrorists&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MjcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNzNiMzY3NS1iZDk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CuqzavdKID52YRlOdYZi_3U305xfF_F7ra-obvZCPOw=)[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42137616/331782195/416963966?refcode=X_022322_TeachersAreTerrorists&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MjcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNzNiMzY3NS1iZDk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CuqzavdKID52YRlOdYZi_3U305xfF_F7ra-obvZCPOw=)[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42137617/331782196/2089498197?refcode=X_022322_TeachersAreTerrorists&amount=500&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MjcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNzNiMzY3NS1iZDk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CuqzavdKID52YRlOdYZi_3U305xfF_F7ra-obvZCPOw=)

body:
Andy knows that jobs, our state's economy, and infrastructure aren't partisan issues – they're the pathway to a better future for all Kentuckians. That's why as governor, he's prioritized revitalizing Kentucky's infrastructure and creating good jobs and safer conditions in our commonwealth. Peter,

Andy knows that jobs, our state's economy, and infrastructure aren't partisan issues – they're the pathway to a better future for all Kentuckians. That's why as governor, he's prioritized revitalizing Kentucky's infrastructure and creating good jobs and safer conditions in our commonwealth.

**Since being elected, Andy's worked to make Kentucky a leader in infrastructure investments. Here are just a few of his accomplishments so far:**

✅ Implemented the Better Kentucky plan to create 14,500 new jobs, build new schools, update vocational centers, and more.
✅ Secured $87 million in infrastructure project investments through the Department for Local Government.
✅ Invested over $1 billion in projects through the Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC).
✅ Accelerated the Mountain Parkway expansion in Eastern Kentucky.
✅ Allocated $250 million for water and wastewater grants to improve the quality of life for Kentuckians while boosting our infrastructure. Delivering clean drinking water is estimated to create 3,800 new jobs.

Andy's already accomplished so much to improve our state's infrastructure, and he's just getting started. Earlier this year, he announced his budget plan which includes historic investments to create and attract jobs of the future, increase access to high-speed internet, continue to clean up our water, and more.

As we work to recover from the COVID-19 pandemic, these investments in our infrastructure are putting Kentuckians back to work and ensuring we create a brighter, safer, more equitable future for all.

Thanks,

name: Nikki Fried
subject: We need to stand together on this, Peter
disclaimer_text: paid for and approved by Nikki Fried, Democrat, for Governor
body:
Peter,

Yesterday, the Florida House heard questions and amendments on the GOP’s “Don’t Say Gay” bill, which bans discussions of sexual orientation and gender identity in our schools.

Now, I know you’ve heard a lot about this bill. But there's a good reason for it — because this bill is one of the most cruel, dangerous, and authoritarian policies that DeSantis and his allies have tried to force on our state.

Peter, this is bigger than any one political race. This is bigger than any partisan battle. This is about protecting our children.

So today, I’m asking you to help stop this bill and stop this cruelty by making a contribution to Equality Florida. Click here to join me in supporting Equality Florida and their efforts to keep LGBTQ kids safe. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/freetosaygay]

When the GOP tried to tack on an amendment that would force schools to share information on a child’s sexuality, Equality Florida fought back. And with your help, they killed the amendment.

But that doesn’t change the fact that this bill is a disgrace, Peter — that it will alienate LGBTQ youth and leave them with no place to turn.

This hateful, bigoted, and cruel piece of legislation has no place in our state.

I’m proud to stand with Equality Florida in the fight against the “Don’t Say Gay” bill. And I hope you’ll stand with me, Peter. Click here to make a donation to Equality Florida and help put a stop to the GOP’s attack on the LGBTQ community. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/freetosaygay]

With thanks,
Nikki

Hi Peter,

Tina is fearless when it comes to working hard to improve the future for everyone.

This is very clear in her legislative work fighting for Oregonians. But she has also broken down barriers as the **first** out lesbian to lead a State House, and when she becomes Governor, she'll be the **first** out lesbian Governor in the country as well.

This is important for young people - in Oregon and around the country - who may not have found their voice and power yet. When Tina becomes the first openly lesbian Governor in American history, she will be showing young queer kids that they can do it, too. We all need someone like ourselves to look up to.

Expanded leave for caregivers is critically important.

| Hi Peter,

All my life, I’ve been a caregiver for my family: for my younger siblings growing up, for the families in our community as a military spouse, for my children, and for my parents as they aged.

As my parents got older, and as my father lived with Parkinson’s Disease, they wanted to remain at home, surrounded by loved ones. Our family juggled time and resources to keep our parents at home. **We need to expand leave opportunities for caregivers who work outside the home, so the elderly can remain at home.**

**[I will support legislation that helps workers take time away from their jobs for caregiving. Sign on now to tell our lawmakers you do, too>>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42139254/331791114/-1791376964?refcode=ea.ab4100a6-c294-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.ab4100a6-c294-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzk0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYjQxMDBhNi1jMjk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Qb15TI6hnB-_2hkRjmPTIhQScFQelf1VlQbT1tjwWIE=&emci=b2655832-1a94-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=ab4100a6-c294-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=5944225)**

I was a chubby kid.

[I won't lie, growing up “fat” was hard.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42139946/331794404/-451217501?refcode=EM_BS_GEL_220223_FR_OVERWEIGHT_A0_na_U1_X1_M1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMTllMzIwNy1jNDk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zBzs7TIzLgKB6UtpP90mWGGcQ93ZycGJuodS2neWimI=) I’m about to tell you about my childhood struggle with my weight and how it impacts my politics — [ but first, could you please chip in $5?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42139947/331794405/-451217501?refcode=EM_BS_GEL_220223_FR_OVERWEIGHT_A0_na_U1_X1_M1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMTllMzIwNy1jNDk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zBzs7TIzLgKB6UtpP90mWGGcQ93ZycGJuodS2neWimI=) | | | [CHIP IN $5 >>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42139948/331794406/1783234547?refcode=EM_BS_GEL_220223_FR_OVERWEIGHT_A0_na_U1_X1_M1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMTllMzIwNy1jNDk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zBzs7TIzLgKB6UtpP90mWGGcQ93ZycGJuodS2neWimI=)
---
| | CHIP IN $10 >>
---
I was always a bigger kid. One of my earliest memories from childhood is being told I was "big boned."

_As you can probably imagine, school was not pleasant!_

[But you know what was actually worse than the teasing? Being made to feel ignored, othered, and unwanted.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42139949/331794407/-451217501?refcode=EM_BS_GEL_220223_FR_OVERWEIGHT_A0_na_U1_X1_M1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMTllMzIwNy1jNDk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zBzs7TIzLgKB6UtpP90mWGGcQ93ZycGJuodS2neWimI=)

My experience — and I know I'm not alone on this — is that the world will often treat you as less deserving of love, attention, and respect if your body does not conform to conventional standards. It can be nearly impossible not to internalize that.

No matter what I look like and no matter what the scale says that identity as a "fat kid" will always be there.

My experience of having known that feeling of being ignored, discounted, and judged — of the injustice of being treated cruelly for no other reason than my weight — is absolutely central to my politics and the way that I treat other people every day of my life.

Hi friends,

Black History Month is a time of the year that we should be learning from and uplifting the Black community. However, celebrating and honoring Black people and history should not be limited to just one month, but it should be a year-round exercise for all of us.

It is important that we build together and alongside the Black community in Wisconsin to create _real_ transformational change for _all_ \-- from citizens to the activists and businesses of our community.

This Black History Month we are determined to make it unlike any other, we want the focus to be on organizing, investing in, and engaging with the Black community in our district to build long-term political power. There are so many ways for us to get involved this Black History Month, and we challenge you to commit to doing the work with us. Here are some ways to get involved:
* **[Become a member at the NAACP](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42140444/331796710/-2088288620?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTY2NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmOGFhMWJlZS1jNjk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Z5UjwOJf930auHjtTKwrhEdNaWbCOjpr7uJhpeJk_ZI=&emci=018db253-4f94-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=f8aa1bee-c694-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=15639879)** and join a network of activists standing up to injustice, fighting back against systemic racism, and answering the call for equality.
* **[Donate to BLOC](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42140445/331796711/703226419?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTY2NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmOGFhMWJlZS1jNjk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Z5UjwOJf930auHjtTKwrhEdNaWbCOjpr7uJhpeJk_ZI=&emci=018db253-4f94-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=f8aa1bee-c694-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=15639879)** \-- a community of Black activists working hard to organize the Black community right here in Wisconsin to ensure a high quality of life and access to opportunities for members of the Black community right here in Wisconsin. Support their work today by making a donation.
* Support Black-owned businesses in Wisconsin making an impact in the community. The next time you're looking for something to eat, try to find a black-owned restaurant or grab a shirt from a black-owned store.
* Celebrate black voices and the best way to do this is by honoring some of the community's most illuminating stories. This Black History Month (and for the rest of the year) we recommend adding books by Black authors to your reading list. Our list includes **Jazz** by Toni Morrison, **All About Love** by Bell Hooks, and **Love in Color** by Bolu Babalola.
* Have conversations with your friends, family, and neighbors. These conversations may be uncomfortable to have -- the ones about race, inequality, and injustice in America -- but they are ones we _need_ to have. It is on all of us to have the difficult conversations that will move us forward as a community.

Black creators, activists, and entrepreneurs of our communities are doing incredible work all across Wisconsin. Here at Team Roe, we know that it is our responsibility to **show up and fight alongside them right here in Wisconsin.**

Let's use this Black History Month to go further by showing up for those who are creating change and fighting for justice in our communities.

Thank you for showing up alongside us,

\-- Team Roe

Putin's "peacekeeping" mission to support the Russian separatists in eastern Ukraine is counterintuitive to peace in these two regions. I am still hopeful that strong punishment by sanctions and diplomatic unity will deter Russia. At what cost will the world stand up to Russia? Will China and others further threaten global Democracy and worldwide recovery from the COVID pandemic? These are all unanswered questions that will unfold over days, weeks, months, and years. Let's work toward resolving this volatile and fragile situation peacefully without significant loss of life, not to mention economic collapse. This conflict affects global inflation and the stock markets — the potential adverse consequences are serious, but they are secondary to the fight for Democracy and self-governance. The U.S. stands tall and true for universal democratic principles and supports Ukraine's struggle for freedom. Earnest attempts at sanctions and diplomacy are not yet exhausted, but it is crucial that Russia back down. Putin must be prevented from building back the USSR.

Especially in rural areas across the country, in states like Georgia, Missouri, Texas, Virginia, and Wisconsin, Republican politicians are fighting to restrict books and lessons on topics like the impact of slavery. In essence, Republicans are trying to control what our kids learn by silencing teachers and erasing topics that dig into the challenges of our country's history. body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._YeRR5ZYMqSjNZ2IWw)
---
Fellow American, Nothing like this has been done before. And I know it will have a major impact on our fight to save free speech. Speech First is preparing a first-of-its-kind report to document and expose Bias Response Teams - or, as we call them, "Censor Squads" - at more than 800 public colleges and universities across the country. **This report could be a game-changer for protecting free speech on college campuses ... but I need the support of concerned Americans like you, Fellow American, to accomplish this goal.** [**Can I count on your gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, or more right now? Your support will help ensure that Speech First is able to expose Bias Response Teams across the country - and hold schools accountable.**](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)
---
[**Expose the Squads Now**](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._SSg9d3Ig)
---
"Censor Squads" are official school structures under which students can be reported for "offensive" speech. Of course, in practice, speech that gets reported the most is disproportionately the opinions and perspectives that don't fit the far-left, progressive majority on campus - whether that's students who live by their religious values or support conservative candidates and causes. **Exposing "Censor Squads" at schools across the country will be a MAJOR victory in our fight to support free speech at colleges and universities ... and Speech First won't stop this important work** until students can engage in academic discourse without fearing administrative action. We're up against well-funded and highly-organized free speech opponents, including universities with multimillion-dollar endowments and high-paid legal teams. But I know that free speech supporters like you, Fellow American, will support us in this fight - and that, if we stand together, we can and WILL win. [**Will you support Speech First's critical work to document and EXPOSE Bias Response Teams (or "Censor Squads") right now? We rely solely on the aid of concerned citizens like you. Please give $25, $50, $100, $250, $500 or more today.**](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._xdA0jeUw3nohDczYQfOgw)
---
[**Expose the Squads Now**](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._Cco60BNNKOZR6Q)
---
Speech First's Bias Response Team report will provide a deep dive into this damaging, and often unconstitutional, university practice ... expose the worst offenders ... document clearly how these secretive groups operate ... and make the case for what can be done to rein them in. But this vital research depends on the support of free speech advocates like you. [**Please help us hold colleges and universities accountable for their Censor Squads - make your most generous gift to Speech First right now.**](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.) By coming together, we're creating a nationwide community of free speech supporters to reassure students that they won't fight these cases alone and that they'll be supported every step of the way: on campus, in the media, and in court. Thank you for sharing your resources with Speech First to tell these students that they have allies who will always be cheering them on.
---

We don’t get what we don’t fight for. We’re up against a lot of problems. And so many of them have been inflicted on our nation by Washington Republicans: | | | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42143339/331809267/-1964596891?ms=em-header&refcode=EMZ3O_EOM_E_20220223_V1S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMGJlZmQxZS1kMjk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Uv8bop9tSxwFQESODpF-T3Oh_PmiGb6xfad8UQwK50o=&emci=cee52e18-d294-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=b0befd1e-d294-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=9027908)

I’ll be blunt: We’re up against a lot of problems. And so many of them have been inflicted on our nation by Washington Republicans:
* An extremist Supreme Court signaling that it is ready to overturn Roe v. Wade.
* Big Pharma driving up prices for drugs and forcing some families to choose between taking their medications and putting food on the table.
* Republicans defending the Big Lie that Trump won the election — and The Bigger Lie that the armed attack on our Capitol that left 150 Capitol police injured, windows broken, and feces spread on the walls was “legitimate political discourse.”

Yeah, there’s a lot of trouble in our nation. There are threats to our safety, to our economic security, to our health, and to our very democracy. **And when there’s this much trouble, we can whimper. We can whine. Or we can fight back. Me? name: Pro Life Update
subject: What is our purpose?
body:
I’m writing to let you know about something I think you’ll find useful in your learning.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zp9mtrs8bjja83nb715ne793cnbeutcnstnqmda8_rp22sh2s8i66ob5cdj69oj1c3h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq0sjnm6qb6d9le1oj8cbl6ej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf4clhcmpbct1h6ior6srkc5grdc75cuqj4o3jm9pm8olk6di7ctj2epi7dctjm1jt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or7m8qmcc9imdiefclkcor61cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn49fg)
This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z62hs30btpp1f2l9eh1310j40gndntifomlvvn5o_rp22sh2s8i66ob5cdj69oj1c3h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I hope your day is going well. I’m writing to let you know about something I think you’ll find useful in your learning. Reason and speech are gifts from God that enable us to think about God and to worship Him. [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2ztjbkj3999d8ec2vl291v6l7uiu9pp1port9cq3g_rp22sh2s8i66ob5cdj69oj1c3h2bs) One of the chief aims of education at Hillsdale College is to understand what kind of being we are, as well as our purpose. That, in turn, makes it possible to begin to understand our relationship to God.

The study of God, also known as “theology,” has had a profound impact on Western civilization, stretching back thousands of years to the ancient Hebrews. And that’s what Hillsdale’s **“Theology 101”** online course is about—the development of theology from the Old Testament through the twentieth century.

**“Theology 101”** has been a popular course, so I’m pleased to let you know that it is [**now available for you to own on DVD**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zfprhr82k3oa08ne8cle8pdg0vtar2m7pn3j435g_rp22sh2s8i66ob5cdj69oj1c3h2bs). You can add it to your home library or give it as a gift to a friend or relative.

We do have a limited number of sets in stock, though—and they go fast—so don’t delay in getting your copy of **“Theology 101”** on DVD. Secure yours right now at: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/support-hillsdales-online-courses-theology-101-dvd](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2ze51la4tgrmc1csvtt1hmgisje323cqr8hnmibs8_rp22sh2s8i66ob5cdj69oj1c3h2bs)** Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

subject: Why wouldn't you want a clean Lake Erie?

body:
Dear Friend,

President Biden's infrastructure law is set to invest in cleaning up a legacy of industrial pollution in Lake Erie, providing $1 billion for this huge job. You'd think everyone, especially lawmakers from the area, would agree that this is good news!

Not U.S. Rep. Mike “Used Car” Kelly. He's been belittling this much-needed investment in his congressional district. He and his cohorts on the Hill have called the infrastructure bill wasteful when in D.C., but back home in PA, Kelly touted the benefits of the plan to voters.

Specifically, Kelly called it "reckless spending." This is money that will pay for historic investments in our waterways and to bolster climate resilience!

We need elected officials who want us to live well, who want our environments to be clean and cared for — isn't this why we vote them into office?

Our movement to mobilize voters is building steam, but we need your help now, so that we can organize voters and create coalitions to make sure our rights and democracy are secure. Support our work with a donation today.

name: Tobias Read
subject: My plan to reduce gun violence
body:
Last year Portland saw the highest gun crime numbers ever reported. There were 1,288 shootings and nearly 70 homicides involving guns.
---
| | Dear Peter, Last year Portland saw the highest gun crime numbers ever reported. There were 1,288 shootings and nearly 70 homicides involving guns. Hundreds of people were wounded in shootings across the city. **Those numbers are higher than much larger cities around the country, and it’s a problem we have to take on now before more lives are lost.** **[I’ve put together a strong, proactive plan to tackle the rapid increase in gun crime that I hope you’ll consider.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42144045/331812444/-1375023676?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzI2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNTY0ZjE3ZC1kMzk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NnLQYrDWAay5xiji934l5xINiZeB2fJmWMtS1mRDmCc=&emci=a36ec977-d394-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=e564f17d-d394-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=30662126)** We’ve been national leaders in gun violence prevention, with universal background checks and safe storage laws on the books. But the numbers make clear that those laws, and the increased funding for mental health supports that came with them, are not enough. As your next Governor I will push for:
* “Ghost gun,” assault weapon, and high capacity magazine bans to help prevent mass shootings and remove untraceable weapons from circulation
* Increased state funding for community based, community led gun violence and gang violence prevention programs, paired with expanded local police units dedicated to prevent such violence
* Fully funded implementation and enforcement of existing laws like the red flag law and the safe storage law

**There’s so much more that I plan to do as Governor.** My plan covers mental and behavioral health, hate crime prevention, suicide prevention, and other issues that are contributing to our gun violence problem. **[You can read my full gun violence plan here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42144046/331812447/-1375023676?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzI2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNTY0ZjE3ZC1kMzk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NnLQYrDWAay5xiji934l5xINiZeB2fJmWMtS1mRDmCc=&emci=a36ec977-d394-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=e564f17d-d394-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=30662126)** Thanks,

Peter -

I am introducing legislation that would temporarily grant asylum to innocent Canadian protesters who are being persecuted by their own government. **We cannot be silent as our neighbors to the north are treated so badly.**

Prime Minister Justin Trudeau’s heavy-handed crackdown against peaceful protesters in Canada is not the action of a Western Democracy, but that of an authoritarian regime like Venezuela or Cuba.

**Just as we provide asylum for political prisoners, we should do the same for truckers who have been subjected to violence, had their property confiscated, and their bank accounts frozen _by a government that is quickly becoming the embarrassment of the free world._**

| | Team, I’ve never backed down from a tough fight. I grew up with parents who instilled in me at a young age the importance of taking action — and that there’s no time to waste in doing good. And that’s exactly what I’ve done in the State Senate — take action to win bold, transformational change for working families — even when things were hard. In 2017 as I fought for criminal justice reform, I wasn’t afraid to call out Beacon Hill leadership for dragging their feet on critical legislation and failing to live up to their word. I’ve seen families torn apart by the criminal legal system — I was proud to take on this fight because it is unacceptable to deliver even less than half measures when Bay Staters are facing urgent inequities. I wasn’t afraid to launch my campaign for Governor even when it meant going up against a well financed Republican incumbent. subject: We must remember to conserve
body:
To be the party of freedom, we must rededicate ourselves to being the party of conservatism | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/shawnhyland.com/abetteramericastartstoday-8851150?e=5167ed8367)
---
| | | | | | _Peter,_ I am a conservative. I believe that to defend the American way of life, the American dream, and the American spirit of freedom, we must _conserve_ the culture, traditions, and laws that gave rise to the American experiment in self-government.Historically, both major political parties believed in **the fundamental pillars of a free people - strong families, faith in God, personal responsibility, hard work, and a sincere patriotic love for one’s country**. The political debate was over the size and scope of government.The Democratic party believed government could be a force for good in society by confiscating people’s finances through higher taxes to fund a well-intended but never-ending list of government interests and interventions. The Republican party believed a smaller limited government allowed everyday ordinary people to enjoy their life more fully and more freely by taxing less money to allow people to pursue their personal interests. Those were the good old days. Today, the political contrast is much starker and the debate much more intense.Tragically, the fundamental pillars of a free people have now been labeled as oppressive by ideological left-wing activist organizations and even tax funded institutions. This new political reality has caused some to reasonably conclude that the Republican party on the right is the party of Freedom, while the Democrat party on the left is the party of Oppression. We are told America’s dualistic choice between the major political parties is one of Liberty or Lockdowns.Republican thought leaders believe the one word that sums up the Republican platform is – Freedom. Libertarians, populists, small businesses, and the working-class desire to be free from the mandates and dictates of big oversized ineffective government. Yes, but...We must remember to _**conserve**_**.** Freedom is not willed into existence by the people, nor can it be maintained by an idealistic protectionism. **Freedom is built on the longstanding Western values of individualism and equal rights.** One man could not rule over another without their consent. This political philosophy is rooted in the Judeo-Christian understanding of each person being made in the image of God. For this reason, the American founding fathers appealed to the Laws of Nature and of Nature’s God to support their claim of inalienable God-given rights.Therefore, to be the party of Freedom, we must rededicate ourselves to being the party of _**Conservatism**_. The nuclear family is not dispensable. Moral goodness is not repressive.The radical far left knows this more than many of us. Influential socialist organizations that become the breeding ground for the likes of Bernie Sanders and Alexandria Ocasio Cortez, such as Liberation Road, Democratic Socialists of America, Communist Party USA, and more all insist in their online mission statements on dismantling the nuclear family and deconstructing moral values to fundamentally transform society to their Marxist end.We cannot allow them to advance their destructive agenda. Every principled republican must stand firm on _**conserving**_ the culture, traditions, and laws of our nation if we are to pass on freedom to the next generation.
---
| | | | | |
# Working for a Better America,

clean_body: To be the party of freedom, we must rededicate ourselves to being the party of conservatism | | | | | | | | | Peter, I am a conservative. I believe that to defend the American way of life, the American dream, and the American spirit of freedom, we must conserve the culture, traditions, and laws that gave rise to the American experiment in self-government.Historically, both major political parties believed in the fundamental pillars of a free people - strong families, faith in God, personal responsibility, hard work, and a sincere patriotic love for one’s country. The political debate was over the size and scope of government.The Democratic party believed government could be a force for good in society by confiscating people’s finances through higher taxes to fund a well-intended but never-ending list of government interests and interventions. The Republican party believed a smaller limited government allowed everyday ordinary people to enjoy their life more fully and more freely by taxing less money to allow people to pursue their personal interests. Those were the good old days. Today, the political contrast is much starker and the debate much more intense.Tragically, the fundamental pillars of a free people have now been labeled as oppressive by ideological left-wing activist organizations and even tax funded institutions. This new political reality has caused some to reasonably conclude that the Republican party on the right is the party of Freedom, while the Democrat party on the left is the party of Oppression. We are told America’s dualistic choice between the major political parties is one of Liberty or Lockdowns.Republican thought leaders believe the one word that sums up the Republican platform is – Freedom. Libertarians, populists, small businesses, and the working-class desire to be free from the mandates and dictates of big oversized ineffective government. Yes, but...We must remember to conserve. Freedom is not willed into existence by the people, nor can it be maintained by an idealistic protectionism. Freedom is built on the longstanding Western values of individualism and equal rights. One man could not rule over another without their consent. This political philosophy is rooted in the Judeo-Christian understanding of each person being made in the image of God. For this reason, the American founding fathers appealed to the Laws of Nature and of Nature’s God to support their claim of inalienable God-given rights.Therefore, to be the party of Freedom, we must rededicate ourselves to being the party of Conservatism. The nuclear family is not dispensable. Moral goodness is not repressive.The radical far left knows this more than many of us. Influential socialist organizations that become the breeding ground for the likes of Bernie Sanders and Alexandria Ocasio Cortez, such as Liberation Road, Democratic Socialists of America, Communist Party USA, and more all insist in their online mission statements on dismantling the nuclear family and deconstructing moral values to fundamentally transform society to their Marxist end.We cannot allow them to advance their destructive agenda. Every principled republican must stand firm on conserving the culture, traditions, and laws of our nation if we are to pass on freedom to the next generation. | | | | | | Working for a Better America, Shawn Hyland| | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | | | Copyright (C) 2022 ShawnHyland.com. I’ll be honest, folks — I only have about 10 minutes of free time this afternoon. That’s because I’m on the road visiting with New Mexicans and helping to negotiate our Omnibus Appropriations bill, working to deliver both for New Mexicans and for veterans and servicemen and women across our country. Today, I want to take these 10 minutes to share a bit about why I came to the U.S. Senate to represent New Mexico in the first place. Growing up, my parents taught me the value of hard work. My dad was an immigrant and union lineman with the local utility company. My mom was a seamstress and an automobile tire factory worker. I worked my way through college to earn a mechanical engineering degree and started my career at what’s now known as the Air Force Research Laboratory at Kirtland Air Force Base in Albuquerque, working on directed energy. Then I learned firsthand about the importance of conservation work in rural communities as an AmeriCorps fellow. Before running for public office, I also worked for and with nonprofits, including leading an organization that helped kids get outdoors, and to help elect Democrats to the state legislature. From there, I served in the Albuquerque City Council, as a Natural Resources Trustee for New Mexico, in the U.S. House, and now in the U.S. Senate — always focusing on delivering for the people of New Mexico and tackling the climate crisis. Right now, my number one priority is to continue my work in the Senate, addressing the challenges we face head-on. That means improving lives for you and your family, acting on climate change, and propeling New Mexico and our country into the clean energy future. **Now that you’ve taken some time to learn more about how I got here, I hope you’ll help me stay in the Senate by chipping in $10 or more to my re-election campaign before our end-of-month deadline expires.
