| | Dear Patriot:

Yesterday, I drove down to our State Capitol in Little Rock and officially filed to be on the ballot.

This was the first major hurdle, and we passed!

The Republican Party of Arkansas didn’t want me on the ballot—since the very first day of my campaign, the corrupt RINOs who control the GOP have done everything they can to silence me.

But it didn't work. They couldn't stop me.

The Arkansas GOP is an incumbent protection racket, designed to prevent grassroots America First candidates like myself from challenging crooked corporate stooges like my opponent, Deep State Steve Womack.

This fall,**the Carroll County GOP threw me offstage** at its Lincoln Day Dinner when I called out my opponent—to his face—for certifying the stolen 2020 election and voting with Nancy Pelosi for her Sham January 6th Witch Hunt.

Then, **the Republican Party of Arkansas disavowed me** as a “racist, sexist, bigot,” blacklisting me as a “non-recommended candidate.”

**Look at how easily they turn into cancel culture leftists -- calling me named like "bigoted" and "sexist," just like the Communist Democrats! **

_They’re treating me the _same _way that they treated President Trump._

**Of course, the reason they talk like Democrats is because they _are _Democrats.**

The very next day, **the GOP got me banned from my online payment processor** , Anedot.

In December, **the America Last Republican National Committee banned me from WinRed, their own fundraising platform**.

_I had to pay the Arkansas GOP—the same thugs who are trying to drag my name through the mud—a **$15,000** “filing fee” just to get on the ballot._

Keep in mind that this is one of the _highest_ —if not _the _highest—filing fees in the entire country, while Arkansas remains one of the _poorest_ States in the country.

**The _only _purpose for such a high barrier of entry is to protect their Establishment cronies from candidates like myself—candidates who actually represent the American people.**

They _FAILED_ to keep me off of the ballot.

On May 24th, voters will see my name on the Republican ticket right alongside my opponent.

I’m personally invested in this struggle, in our fight for America’s future. **I put $30,000 of my own money into this campaign.**

**[_Help my campaign offset the cost of the GOP's $15,000 ransom fee by pitching in today._

_Defy the RINO Establishment by chipping in today. Each contribution sends them the message that they can't protect their cronies from Patriot primary challengers for a second longer--that we are coming __for_ _ them_ _._](https://NeilforArkansas.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b07b27c744909d0ecfce3d46&id=0f6b9a50c5&e=eda539b26b)**

Remember: They’re not just trying to silence and smear me; they’re trying to silence and smear YOU.

[_**Your contributions to my campaign will help me purchase TV and radio ads, yard signs, and other campaign materials so I can fight the worthless GOP, retire a weak RINO, and replace him with a fierce America First Warrior**_.](https://NeilforArkansas.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b07b27c744909d0ecfce3d46&id=92e7725dbb&e=eda539b26b)

Thank you in advance for your generous support. For America,
Neil Robinson Kumar
_Republican for U.S. Congress, AR-03_

**P.S. The Republican Party of Arkansas is pulling out all the stops to kill my authentic America First campaign. ** [_**I know you're ready to replace these worthless RINOs with America First conservatives like me, and that's why I'm counting on your contribution of $5, $10, $25, $50, $100, $250, $500 or more today**_](https://NeilforArkansas.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b07b27c744909d0ecfce3d46&id=ac860ee35e&e=eda539b26b)** _._**

clean_body: SIGN THE PETITION: Asylum for Canadian Truck Drivers | Peter - I am introducing legislation that would temporarily grant asylum to innocent Canadian protesters who are being persecuted by their own government. We cannot be silent as our neighbors to the north are treated so badly. Prime Minister Justin Trudeau’s heavy-handed crackdown against peaceful protesters in Canada is not the action of a Western Democracy, but that of an authoritarian regime like Venezuela or Cuba. Just as we provide asylum for political prisoners, we should do the same for truckers who have been subjected to violence, had their property confiscated, and their bank accounts frozen by a government that is quickly becoming the embarrassment of the free world. STAND WITH CANADIAN TRUCK DRIVERS NOW When I was elected by the American people to the House of Representatives, I took an oath that I would bear true faith and allegiance to the Constitution of the United States. Our founding document ensures that America will embrace freedom and act as a bastion of opportunity for ALL - I'm in Washington to ensure we never lose sight of this promise. These Canadian truck drivers value peace, personal responsibility and liberty - they embody the America we are promised by the Constitution. ## [ENDORSEMENT: Col. Ulysses “Xerk” White, first Black African American elected Manassas Councilman #BlackHistoryMonth](https://theresacoatesellis.com/2022/02/23/endorsement-col-ulysses-xerk-white-first-black-african-american-elected-manassas-councilman-blackhistorymonth/)
by [theresacoatesellis](https://theresacoatesellis.com/?author=1)
---|---
ENDORSEMENT by my friend who broke barriers and made history in Manassas. Colonel Ulysses X. White “Xerk” was the first African American elected to the city council 1990-1994 and then served again 1996-2000.
Xerk served in the U.S. Army for 30 years. He is devoted to his family, community, and his country.
I am so honored to have known him and served side by side with him during my leadership terms as Area Governor of Rotary District 7610 Group, during my Presidency of the ISCC Inter-service Club Council of Greater Manassas, as an advocate for education and opportunity and now as an elected Councilwoman.
Working with the Scouts recently at our event Bee Houses | The Scouts with George + Theresa Ellis, I learned that Xerk has stepped up to a leadership position to lend his expertise and wisdom to our youth.
Thank you to my friend Xerk.

| | The Southern border of the United States is a complicated issue, but many of the residents of Washington's 3rd Congressional district are more concerned with the Southern Border of Washington.Local issues have national consequences. As such, the national government has local obligations. It has been referred to as the "third rail" of Washington's politics, and contrasting opinions abound, but it NEEDS TO BE DISCUSSED! What am I talking about? The I-5 Bridge Replacement Project. This project's need and benefits are not just limited to the Vancouver/Portland metroplex.
---

| | "As the only continuous north-south interstate on the West Coast between Mexico and Canada, I-5 is a vital trade route for regional, national and international economies. With one span now over 100 years old, it is at risk for collapse in the event of a major earthquake and no longer satisfies the needs of modern commerce and travel."[https://wsdot.wa.gov/construction-planning/search-projects/i-5-interstate-bridge-replacement-program](https://www.brenthennrich.com/so/02NyYtXSe/c?w=uwd7rrrvvqvGMxzJvhElsswr8j1Vc-21Ep1aqNup2oY.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93c2RvdC53YS5nb3YvY29uc3RydWN0aW9uLXBsYW5uaW5nL3NlYXJjaC1wcm9qZWN0cy9pLTUtaW50ZXJzdGF0ZS1icmlkZ2UtcmVwbGFjZW1lbnQtcHJvZ3JhbSIsInIiOiI3ZGZmZTYwYy1jMDY2LTRmM2QtZmY3Yi00ZDIxYTAxOTM5M2EiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiJlNDY5NDE2YS0xYWYxLTQ0MzYtODlmMC1kOTMyMjMxM2RkMWEifQ)

| | It is not exaggeration to say that anything which impedes that traffic is bad for our state as well as our Nation. Sadly, like much of our infrastructure, it has become "long in the tooth" yet remains a vital corridor.
* First span constructed in 1917
* Second span constructed in 1958 under the Interstate system created by the Federal-Aid Highway Act
* Crossings in 2018/19 exceeded 138K (record high years)
* Average weekday crossings in 2020 were 120+K (the pandemic saw a drop in crossings)[(Source)](https://www.brenthennrich.com/so/02NyYtXSe/c?w=cNf9sq2a_YsANN7LzIQACHf0BiHqmtiflq8zTeGs-LU.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucnRjLndhLmdvdi9kYXRhL3RyYWZmaWMvYnJpZGdlcy9kYWlseS5hc3AiLCJyIjoiNDc3YzY5MWItNjhhNC00MzcwLTM4YTUtYTU3MGU0NzU0NDFmIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiZTQ2OTQxNmEtMWFmMS00NDM2LTg5ZjAtZDkzMjIzMTNkZDFhIn0)

| | Being heavily utilized and depended upon, the reasons supporting replacement are clear.
* Growing travel demand and congestion
* Seismic vulnerability
* Safety concerns as a result of existing roadway design
* Impaired freight movement
* Inadequate bicycle and pedestrian facilities
* Limited public transportation

In 2012, calls to replace the bridge resulted in the Columbia River Crossing (CRC) project, with costs estimated to start at $3.4 billion. In 2013, Washington's legislature declined to authorize the funding.Without replacement, maintenance costs for the existing bridge are
* At least $1.2 million annually, split between ODOT and WSDOT

Expected to cost over $280 million through the year 2040, not including seismic retrofits Those maintenance costs fail to address the needs that support replacement.
---

| | All of the justifications for replacement embrace the growth occurring now and expected to continue in the future. In light of that, the I-5 Interstate Bridge Replacement Program (2019) began with both WA and OR dedicating funds and directing WSDOT and ODOT to jointly lead the process. I have many concerns about this project. I agree with everyone who sees the actual need to replace the bridge - not just for today, but the future needs of the metroplex. I believe that we can expect real risks associated with deferring to the next generation. There are lurking dangers not just associated with age but also with its lack of earthquake protection systems. Like many, I am concerned with who is fiscally responsible. There is no doubt the people of WA-03 would benefit. The same can be said of Portland residents and the rest of Oregon's population.
---

| | The very fact that this crossing was included in the new Interstate system says very clearly that it serves more than just two cities or two states. The impacts of a collapse or disrepairs resulting in a safety closure of the older span would be felt up and down the Pacific coast. Lumber industries rely on this vital corridor - the effects a closure would cause would be felt in lumber costs to consumers and the paychecks of timber industry employees. The condition of this bridge reaches across our nation's commerce, and much of it flows right the the heart of Washington's Third. I firmly believe this project should be funded by Congress as a vital Federal Interstate project. Replacement funded strictly off of a bond issue in Washington and Oregon, and the tolls which that would incur, puts an unfair burden on our cities and states. As I have stated, we are not the only beneficiaries of replacement. It is an essential part of a Federal Interstate because it is vital for north to south commercial traffic spanning the entire Pacific Coast , effectively connecting the Pacific Coast with Mexico and Canada. In Congress, I will push for federal funds to fund this project as the national infrastructure issue it is. A highway that serves all Americans should be funded by all Americans. However, I cannot do that unless I am in Congress. So if you believe as I do, that local issues have national consequences, [help me get to Congress.](https://www.brenthennrich.com/so/02NyYtXSe/c?w=jwhy-PGPDxMaLukfQdbnM455pfVCVd9uiFE3jkvgl5Y.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2JyZW50MjAyMj9yZWZjb2RlPUk1YnJpZGdlZW1haWwmYW1vdW50PTEwMCIsInIiOiIyZjhjMTFmMC03NzQ3LTQwOWItYWU1ZC1hZTkyZjA5NmI1NmUiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiJlNDY5NDE2YS0xYWYxLTQ0MzYtODlmMC1kOTMyMjMxM2RkMWEifQ)

* Protect a [woman's bodily autonomy](https://www.brenthennrich.com/so/02NyYtXSe/c?w=AIZcun4q5laZWdvQQQ0zegGBhxCoLk1QEjyjM_UwQ_M.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL3dhMDMiLCJyIjoiM2ZmNDY0NzAtMWFlZi00ZmVkLTI2YTktMzU0NDRiZTdkOTAyIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiZTQ2OTQxNmEtMWFmMS00NDM2LTg5ZjAtZDkzMjIzMTNkZDFhIn0) with protected reproductive care, written into law.

In 2013, Washington's legislature declined to authorize the funding.Without replacement, maintenance costs for the existing bridge are At least $1.2 million annually, split between ODOT and WSDOT Expected to cost over $280 million through the year 2040, not including seismic retrofits Those maintenance costs fail to address the needs that support replacement. | | | | | All of the justifications for replacement embrace the growth occurring now and expected to continue in the future. In light of that, the I-5 Interstate Bridge Replacement Program (2019) began with both WA and OR dedicating funds and directing WSDOT and ODOT to jointly lead the process. I have many concerns about this project. I agree with everyone who sees the actual need to replace the bridge - not just for today, but the future needs of the metroplex. I believe that we can expect real risks associated with deferring to the next generation. There are lurking dangers not just associated with age but also with its lack of earthquake protection systems. Like many, I am concerned with who is fiscally responsible. There is no doubt the people of WA-03 would benefit. The same can be said of Portland residents and the rest of Oregon's population. | | | | | The very fact that this crossing was included in the new Interstate system says very clearly that it serves more than just two cities or two states. The impacts of a collapse or disrepairs resulting in a safety closure of the older span would be felt up and down the Pacific coast. Lumber industries rely on this vital corridor - the effects a closure would cause would be felt in lumber costs to consumers and the paychecks of timber industry employees. The condition of this bridge reaches across our nation's commerce, and much of it flows right the the heart of Washington's Third. I firmly believe this project should be funded by Congress as a vital Federal Interstate project. Replacement funded strictly off of a bond issue in Washington and Oregon, and the tolls which that would incur, puts an unfair burden on our cities and states. As I have stated, we are not the only beneficiaries of replacement. It is an essential part of a Federal Interstate because it is vital for north to south commercial traffic spanning the entire Pacific Coast , effectively connecting the Pacific Coast with Mexico and Canada. In Congress, I will push for federal funds to fund this project as the national infrastructure issue it is. A highway that serves all Americans should be funded by all Americans. However, I cannot do that unless I am in Congress. So if you believe as I do, that local issues have national consequences, | | | I want to represent WA-03 to: Defend your rights as and families. | Friends,

Over the next month, I am going to lay out four areas of crisis in America, and ask for your [help](https://traceymann.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60a16ea89a176679a5f31366c&id=8b4927a067&e=a9d1410029) in the fight to take our country back. Today I want to talk about: _Government Spending_.

Government spending has put America in the poorhouse. At $30.3 trillion, our country’s debt is at an all-time high, and Democrats are just making the problem worse. _Since President Biden took office, Americans have been obligated to over $3 trillion dollars in new spending. **This is on top of the $240,569 each taxpayer already owes to the national debt!**_

No one in Washington, D.C. could even figure out how much the Biden Administration’s Build Back Better plan would cost because it contained so many tricks, like fake expiration dates for their spending programs. Fixing the broken supply chain is more important than worrying about coral reefs and electric cars. Nancy Pelosi and House Democrats are living in a fantasy world where money grows on trees and the American taxpayer is stuck with the bill.

The Democrats are spending money like there’s no tomorrow, but tomorrow belongs to our children, and I’m not going to stand idly by and watch while they destroy this country. It’s time for a return to normalcy. Enough is enough.

I am working around the clock to help Republicans take back the House in the upcoming election and I need your help.

_Please kick in $100.00 today and invest in the fight to stop this dangerous spending addiction._ ([Donate here](https://traceymann.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60a16ea89a176679a5f31366c&id=3cfc111926&e=a9d1410029))

With you in the fight,

Tracey Mann

| Friends,
We are now under 70 days until the most important primary election in the country and my campaign is confident we are on the path to victory.
There are many updates we have to share but most importantly, we want to thank you for believing in the Gibbons message and sharing it with your friends and family. This election is a matter of independence or sweeping government control and it will have far-reaching impacts for the second half of Biden's term.
This past week, my statewide bus tour made its way to Northwest Ohio where I stopped in Port Clinton, Toledo, Napoleon and Paulding to meet with supporters.

---
| [ ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001RsLbtnBuI_3l2Fg67Gaqtu-u6ZeuX5l78EPDxcsA3qMClzohzIkhE46Eij6mCTugfMNm1VjfXdu8-KmfgjcLuUbERmzUJdiKWQa0i9eQjCuMkyJYXVu9KgJEas7CvYpw6Xpa4XNs3HFhTc5F1GTBCNByDXw9B75GT4oUqqrswllQ_qM0rGRvk80EjogdzthmwwtQI3DYIZE=&c=OW7bexypNi1rTMouFGOXqBhx_qK-s6a_Vs26FUPmtMBGynpbeBbOxQ==&ch=5p8I2vIJUr03cxM7TS3Vc7J3CiEfOIsB15S-P73q8O2pKOvlC0SiqA==)
---
| | |
---
| In the news this week is the major issue pertaining to the Russian invasion of Ukraine. As someone who grew up in Parma among a vibrant Ukrainian-American community, my thoughts and prayers are with lifelong friends and childhood neighbors who have family in Ukraine.
Russia's invasion of Ukraine is an unacceptable act of unprovoked aggression and must elicit consequences from the international community. Russia should be isolated politically and economically and face tough economic sanctions. While I am one-hundred percent opposed to the deployment of American troops to Ukraine, Russia's invasion must not go unanswered.
Check out my [full statement on the issue here](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001RsLbtnBuI_3l2Fg67Gaqtu-u6ZeuX5l78EPDxcsA3qMClzohzIkhE46Eij6mCTug4lWkmjhmGDIxDfcMLFVPqNHT0LDi6kOIrNH847ngtSqpPoo45cE7rPaaSprESIJ2pJLanJcVWe90Q-UyaOjgCtvgt8ofL83la5WRX2YuIUiPNqH3R_k8EI7z_x9NwEGMd_gZFDijQWVgeEHNn6IwhUcvhT-gJqh_UbpP3G4f2_6JqHpB1KbZQegEi5kzFHFBkjMoTLRv04tQibqnHwuBEQ==&c=OW7bexypNi1rTMouFGOXqBhx_qK-s6a_Vs26FUPmtMBGynpbeBbOxQ==&ch=5p8I2vIJUr03cxM7TS3Vc7J3CiEfOIsB15S-P73q8O2pKOvlC0SiqA==).
As our success has grown, our campaign has become a target from our flailing opponents. The attacks are in full swing, but I promise to stick to my message and not allow the distractions to take down my plan of restoring American First values.

| U.S. Senate candidate Mike Gibbons warns of a couple of "dangers" in a message that he believes will resonant with conservatives -- curbing government spending to control inflation and countering "wokeism."

body:
Peter,
The people in my district are struggling. The median individual income for our district?**Less than $30,000 a year per person. Those are poverty wages.** And in a state as expensive as California, it’s even harder to live on that kind of money.
**[I’m running for Congress to change things on the ground for the people of California’s 23rd district. But I can’t get to Washington, DC without help from supporters like you. We rely on donations to keep going, so I’m asking you: will you chip in today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42150198/331842123/-431919476?refcode=2-22a&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODEyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZGU0MWM3NC1lOTk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jCNdzVymqjr1dZCgazHjf042AGtQ482aU2ma45m3btM=)**

**Too many people in my district are living paycheck to paycheck, struggling to keep themselves and their families afloat.** When you’re living on $24,000 a year, every expense becomes a burden, and any unexpected emergency can put you under water. I should know.
**For three years, I drove for Uber to pay my bills.** I started off my day with a cup of coffee and a banana for less than a dollar, and**I drove for hours and hours until I had enough money to cover my costs for the day.** Then I would wake up the next day and do it all over again.
**[The people of California’s 23rd deserve a representative in Congress who understands their experiences and will fight for their needs. But I can’t become that leader without your help. Will you pitch in and invest in my campaign today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42150200/331842125/-431919476?refcode=2-22a&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODEyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZGU0MWM3NC1lOTk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jCNdzVymqjr1dZCgazHjf042AGtQ482aU2ma45m3btM=)**
**Over half the current members of Congress are millionaires.** Yes, you heard that right: the majority of our legislators are millionaires, in a time when wealth inequality has never been more extreme in America. **We need representatives like me who share the experiences of their constituents. **
**My opponent Jay Obernolte is a multi-millionaire.** He can’t serve the people of California’s 23rd well when he votes for laws which benefit the very same companies that bankroll his campaign. It’s time for fresh, new, ethical leadership.**I’m running for Congress to be that leader. **
**[Our entire campaign runs on 100% grassroots donations. I don’t believe in taking money from corporations or special interests, only real people. As a supporter, will you contribute today and invest in a future where a true champion of the people is representing California’s 23rd in Congress?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42150202/331842126/-431919476?refcode=2-22a&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODEyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZGU0MWM3NC1lOTk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jCNdzVymqjr1dZCgazHjf042AGtQ482aU2ma45m3btM=)**

In solidarity,
**Derek Marshall**
Candidate for U.S. Congress, CA-23

**Voter turnout in Texas primaries is dramatically low.**
**– Texas Tribune** What happens in Texas between now and March 1st matters. It carries over into November and could set the trend across the country. The _Texas Tribune_ reported that voter turnout in Texas primaries is “dramatically low.” Historically, voter participation in midterm primary elections is dismal in Texas, with less than a quarter of registered voters casting ballots most years. To win statewide races in November, Democrats have to do the work right now in the primary. **[Our campaign set the record for voter turnout in Texas in 2020, and we’re working on our field game right now to reach voters where they are. I need your help in this final stretch to get folks to the polls – can you donate $5, $35 or $50 so we can get out the vote?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42138054/331784381/-780221392?amount=10&refcode=pl_20220222_01&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NjQ2OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NGFlZWQzZC1jMDk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vH3duw8-DeD8dLqmMtLFXmkV0EXLdgu8_UfgZE_JEPM=)** With many burnt out from the 2020 election, and tuned out, voter turnout is not off to a sweeping start with early voting. Additionally, Texas Senate Bill 1, passed in 2021, is causing unusually high mail-in-ballot rejections because of mismatch in identification numbers on the ballots. We knew this was coming and now we’re dealing with the ramifications of it. **For Texas, 2022 is everything.** We're up against restrictive voting laws, reproductive health care laws, and gerrymandering that does not reflect the diversity of Texas. | Peter, Canceling student loan debt and ensuring access to higher education for all Americans is more than simply a winning political issue for the Biden Administration — it’s about our values. As Americans, we cannot stand by and watch as so many struggle under the dark cloud of debt just to have access to education. A truly equitable and robust recovery from COVID-19 should be a New Deal moment. We cannot just return to February 2020, instead we need to forge a more just future by addressing the long-standing systemic challenges that keep opportunity out of the hands of too many. **That’s why I am proud to be the first and only U. S. Secretary of Education to call for the unilateral cancellation of student debt. ** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42150447/331843130/-1262551449?source=email-ngp-20220223-b1_fr_full-JK_S1_C1&&&&refcode=email-ngp-20220223-b1_fr_full-JK_S1_C1&&&&utm_medium=email&&&&utm_source=ngp&&&&utm_campaign=20220223&&&&utm_content=b1_fr_full&&&&utm_term=JK_S1_C1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NGQ2NDI5MC1lYTk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=z7dx0wgWiB9gHR0QRnHf5I3Gse9t8g4ewqqUpB-0S3M=&emci=99c4268a-ea94-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=54d64290-ea94-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=24635484)

The student debt crisis falls disproportionately on students and families of color and both reflects and exacerbates the racial wealth gap in our country. It’s time we take action to address this, and we must approach canceling student debt with an equity-focused lens. In order to create an economy that breaks down barriers to opportunity and lifts everyone up, **I am calling on President Biden to act now to cancel student debt.** If you want to read more about my experience with student debt and my call to action for President Biden, you can read my newly released Business Insider op-ed here: _**[https://johnkingforgovernor.com/news-article/cancel-student-debt/](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42150449/331843132/-1262551449?source=email-ngp-20220223-b1_fr_full-JK_S1_C1&&&&refcode=email-ngp-20220223-b1_fr_full-JK_S1_C1&&&&utm_medium=email&&&&utm_source=ngp&&&&utm_campaign=20220223&&&&utm_content=b1_fr_full&&&&utm_term=JK_S1_C1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NGQ2NDI5MC1lYTk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=z7dx0wgWiB9gHR0QRnHf5I3Gse9t8g4ewqqUpB-0S3M=&emci=99c4268a-ea94-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=54d64290-ea94-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=24635484)**_ | [READ THE OP-ED](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42150450/331843133/-1262551449?source=email-ngp-20220223-b1_fr_full-JK_S1_C1&&&&refcode=email-ngp-20220223-b1_fr_full-JK_S1_C1&&&&utm_medium=email&&&&utm_source=ngp&&&&utm_campaign=20220223&&&&utm_content=b1_fr_full&&&&utm_term=JK_S1_C1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NGQ2NDI5MC1lYTk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=z7dx0wgWiB9gHR0QRnHf5I3Gse9t8g4ewqqUpB-0S3M=&emci=99c4268a-ea94-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=54d64290-ea94-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=24635484)

Hello, Peter. One of the first patients I treated as a medical student was a 14 year old girl with a stomach ache. I had to break the news to her that she was pregnant. As her doctor, I was able to help her make a choice about her body and her future — a choice that belonged to her and only her. Peter,

The Biden agenda is directly driving the HIGHEST INFLATION since the 1980s!

Inflation, aka the silent tax, is at 7.5% and _it’s gutting our savings_ , _closing small businesses_ , and _ending people's livelihoods_.

What does that amount to?

_**Destroyed American Dreams...**_

Failed liberal policies have caused record-breaking, out-of-control inflation.

We need new leadership in Washington because America literally cannot afford the Biden agenda anymore.

I've always been guided by these core principles: _faith in God and country_ , _a strong united family_ , and _service before self_.

And that’s what American leadership is lacking these days--we have a lot of people in government who either talk a good game about helping the American people or are the career politicians who are getting things done.

But real leaders can do both.

Leadership is more than just listening to people’s concerns, it’s sacrificing your own needs behind someone else's and not accepting failure as an option.

We need a leader who can restore faith in the American system, be a champion for American families, and serve and fulfill the interests of the American public.

subject: Under the Dome - An Update from the Capitol
body:

---
| |
---
| Dear Friend,

I hope all is well!

The Legislature continues to move at full speed. It is critical that Mississippi citizens stay informed so that they can remain knowledgeable about how their legislators are representing them and whether those legislators are working to safeguard our fundamental rights and liberties.

Here’s your update on The Good, The Bad, and The Interesting. I hope you find it helpful!

**The Good:**
**\- Gov. Reeves announced a new program to support Mississippi military families.** The initiative will highlight ways that schools can be more flexible and supportive of students who move districts due to military requirements.

**-_HB 917_ by Rep. Jansen Owen would remove burdensome obstacles from those seeking to participate in home-based work.** With thousands of businesses being started from Mississippians’ homes during the pandemic, it makes tremendous sense that we would reward these folks with continued opportunity rather than punishing their innovative efforts.

**-_HB 512_ by Rep. Trey Lamar would remove the Department of Revenue from being the distributor of alcohol for the state and would allow for the creation of a free-market-oriented system.** It is about time the state eliminated the final remnants of prohibition. Controlling the sale of alcohol is not an essential task of the government.

**The Bad:**
**-_SB 2164_ would create a Department of Tourism.** I am all for encouraging people to come and enjoy the beauties of Mississippi, but we don’t need to continue the government’s vast expansion to accomplish this. Too often, these new departments replicate existing efforts but through a consolidated format that ultimately ends up costing the taxpayers more money.

**\- A range of Mississippi news outlets are pushing for the state to expand Medicaid.** The facts are clear – Medicaid expansion has consistently failed to deliver the desired results. The care that is given often fails to be better than that received without coverage and, in some cases, is actually worse.
Furthermore, up to 50% of payments that the system makes in other states are improper and fraudulent. Altogether, there is no reason to put further trust in a ship that is already sinking. Pushing folks into a broken welfare trap that is spiraling out of control while failing to offer basic care is not compassionate, it’s reckless.

**The Interesting:**
**\- Many of y’all were interested in HB 1487, which makes One Mississippi by Steve Azar the official song of Mississippi.** This bill passed the House and will soon be considered by the Senate. What do you think some potential alternatives to this could be?

Let me know what you think about these policy issues and others moving being considered by the legislature. As always, if you have any questions or thoughts, feel free to reach out!
---
| | [ ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=d36e55cf76&e=5703353baa)
---

All the Best,

Hunter Estes
Senior Director, Policy & Communications

clean_body: That is an unimaginably long time. | | | Dear Team, Every day, all across the country, our reproductive rights are under attack on the state and federal level. Among Black women this isn’t just a threat to our individual freedom, it is a threat to our very survival. , Black women are 3 times more likely to die from pregnancy-related causes than white women. States like Texas are passing the most extreme abortion bans in the country - greenlighting citizen bounty hunters to target people seeking abortion care. The right-wing majority on the Supreme Court is threatening to gut what’s left of Roe v. Wade’ s protections. Our reproductive freedom is facing its greatest threat of the last 50 years. In the face of this existential threat, Danny Davis—who represents a district that is overwhelmingly communities of color—has been shockingly silent. Where is he? nearly every way that Danny Davis could be fighting for his constituents, our Congressman is missing in action. We deserve so much more. We need a leader ready to demand that the Senate pass the Women’s Health Protection Act to codify our constituional right to abortion into law. We need a leader who isn’t afraid to take on the right-wing extremists on the Supreme Court and demand that Congress expand the court. Our reproductive rights matter far too much for us to have a Representative that refuses to stand up for them. IL-7 deserves a reproductive justice champion fighting for us in Congress. Right now, all we are getting from our leader is silence. It is long past time. Thank you, Kina Collins | To give by check: Kina Collins for Congress 901 Lake Street, Unit 4093 Oak Park, IL 60301

| | When people ask who inspired me to run for Governor, I smile and tell them about my Grandmother Neuman. Seeing her strength and tenacity in the face of hardship pushed me to persevere throughout my life. My grandmother left home when she was just 14 years old. She finished high school while living in the attic of one of her relatives, and then went to work as a secretary.
She married and had three children, but her husband passed away early on in their marriage. She suddenly found herself raising three kids alone.
She was now the sole caretaker and provider. There were few social safety nets in place for a newly-widowed single mom.
So Grandmother Neuman went back to school and became a nurse. She worked full-time while putting herself through nursing school – all so she could give her children more comfortable and secure lives.
Like me, my grandmother succeeded in spite of structural failures in Maryland. There should have been more social programs in place to help my struggling grandmother in the wake of her husband’s death.
My story and my grandmother’s story are all too common – folks pulling themselves up by their bootstraps because they have no other choice. But it shouldn’t have to be that way.

clean_body: | = | | When people ask who inspired me to run for Governor, I smile and tell them about my Grandmother Neuman. Seeing her strength and tenacity in the face of hardship pushed me to persevere throughout my life. I want to tell you more about her, but first I have to ask – = | | | = My grandmother left home when she was just 14 years old. She finished high school while living in the attic of one of her relatives, and then went to work as a secretary. She married and had three children, but her husband passed away early on in their marriage. She suddenly found herself raising three kids alone. She was now the sole caretaker and provider. There were few social safety nets in place for a newly-widowed single mom. So Grandmother Neuman went back to school and became a nurse. She worked full-time while putting herself through nursing school – all so she could give her children more comfortable and secure lives. Like me, my grandmother succeeded in spite of structural failures in Maryland. There should have been more social programs in place to help my struggling grandmother in the wake of her husband’s death. My story and my grandmother’s story are all too common – folks pulling themselves up by their bootstraps because they have no other choice. But it shouldn’t have to be that way. That’s why I’m running for Governor – to give every person the tools and opportunities they need to succeed, regardless of their lot in life. body:

| | | Peter,

I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion. We were on an unsustainable path that was mortgaging our children's future.

Fortunately, Americans decided that a government controlled by liberal Democrats wasn't good for the country, and they elected Republicans to the House to halt President Obama's extreme policies. A Republican majority in the Senate followed in 2014.

As I ran for re-election in 2016, we had the prospect of electing a Republican president who could work with a Republican Congress not only to stop the expansion of liberal policies but, we hoped, to reverse some of the damage done during Mr. Obama's administration. I figured we had an opportunity to put America back on the right path, and I was more than willing to dedicate myself to that worthy effort.

By and large, Republican policies worked. Regulatory relief and a more competitive tax system helped create a healthy economy with low inflation and record low unemployment. Strengthening the military deterred our enemies, and policies designed to secure the borders dramatically reduced the flow of illegal immigration.

During the 2016 campaign, I said it would be my last campaign and final term. That was my strong preference, and my wife's--we both looked forward to a normal private life. However, neither of us anticipated the Democrats' complete takeover of government and the disastrous policies they have already inflicted on America and the world, to say nothing of those they threaten to enact in the future.

Nor did we anticipate the pandemic, the government's failed response to it, the loss of freedom that has resulted, and the tyrannical approach taken by the elites who have created and maintained a state of fear that allows them to exercise control over Americans' lives. Instead of everyone working to achieve the goal President Biden stated during his inaugural address--unifying and healing America--it feels as if our nation is being torn apart.

As I travel around Wisconsin and talk to citizens who love our country, I know I am not the only one with grave concerns. My message has always been that America is precious, and it is our solemn duty to make sure it survives and thrives for future generations.

President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches in 2010: This is a fight for freedom. This is not someone else's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.

I believe America is in peril. Much as I'd like to ease into a quiet retirement, I don't feel I should. Countless people have encouraged me to run, saying they rely on me to be their voice, to speak plain and obvious truths other elected leaders shirk from expressing--truths the elite in government, mainstream media, and Big Tech don't want you to hear.

In 2010 I promised I would always tell people the truth and that I would never vote with re-election in mind. When re-election isn't your primary motivation, those are easy promises to keep. Today, I am announcing I will continue to fight for freedom in the public realm by running for re-election. It is a decision I haven't made lightly. Having already experienced a growing level of vitriol and false attacks, I certainly don't expect better treatment in the future. For my campaign to succeed, I will need the support of every American who values the truth and refuses to allow lies and distortions to prevail.

Tens of millions of dollars will be spent trying to destroy and defeat me. The mainstream media and Big Tech will contribute their powerful and corrupt voices as the unofficial but reliable communication apparatus of the Democrats. We face powerful forces that desire even more power and control over our lives. Their path, paved with false hope and greater dependency, always leads to tyranny. We cannot let them win.

So I will humbly ask, Peter, for your endorsement to help me SAVE AMERICA.

subject: A sign of things to come
body:
Parents vs School Boards?
---
| | | | | | Volume 31 | February 23, 2022
---
|
---
| Parents Have Had It!
---
| | |
---|---
|
Parents have had it--and rightfully so. And now, in one of the most liberal cities in our nation, they have acted by successfully removing three school board members from office.

In San Francisco last week, more than 70% of voters supported the recall of the three board members who prioritized a liberal agenda over the education of students. These board members focused on renaming schools in their district over reopening them. Sanitizing history was more important to them than the social and emotional development of children through in-person learning.

This recall is considered a bellwether of what's to come. You see, this was literally liberals voting against liberals because the common sense of conservatives leading this charge was undeniable. This mid-term election is critical in correcting the course our country. We're starting to see it happen, even in a city like San Francisco.

Parents must be in charge of their children's education, and just like any elected official, school boards must represent and support the views of their constituents. Additionally, the federal government should have no hand in our children's education--that's why I support the elimination of the Department of Education. Rather, that money, which currently goes to bureaucracy, should follow the student through a voucher program or go to parents in the form of a tax cut.

Further I support making school choice a priority for children. Their education is one of the most important issues facing our nation. Children are the future of this country and their instruction should be robust; free from a progressive agenda and revisionist history.

We must elect sound thinkers to Congress who will put our children's future first when seeking solutions to the issues that face us today. Join our cause by sending me to Washington. Together we can ensure a bright future for our children, for America.

| Peter, establishment GOP candidates, just like Michelle Lujan Grisham and radical socialists don’t have the best interests of New Mexicans at heart. My pro-police campaign has been constantly under attack. The latest attack came through our court system and I am happy to announce that we successfully thwarted this shameful attempt at kicking me off the ballot. Establishment politicians have wasted taxpayer money with this senseless legal attack against my campaign simply because they are scared of our movement. Peter, that is why I am running to create a safer New Mexico.

Creating a safe New Mexico is one of my top priorities. This is why I have been endorsed by the most law enforcement officials out of all the candidates in this race.

There are many things Idahoans should know about Brad Little before casting their votes in the Republican Primary Election this May. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/janicemcgeachin/02-23-2022?e=823fa8e224)
---
| | [ ](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=5fa162ab2f&e=823fa8e224)

| | Dear Friends,
---
| Did you see my latest video? It's titled, _**Did You Know?**_ and it talks about some of the things Idahoans should know about Brad Little before casting their votes in the Republican Primary Election this May.
---
| [ ](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=1a0af947bb&e=823fa8e224)
---
Click above to watch the video
| Our world grows ever more unstable as Russian President Putin inches closer to war with Ukraine and Canadian Prime Minster Justin Trudeau continues to arrest protesters and seize their assets. Kentucky Senator Rand Paul recently described Trudeau's unprecedented power grab as "[very, very dangerous](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=22ec1dc115&e=823fa8e224)" and discussed his efforts to prevent similar misuse of expanded emergency powers in the U.S. Of course, here in Idaho, we know something about the abuse of emergency powers. In 2020, Gov. Little declared an emergency and used his expanded powers under that declaration to shut down businesses, declare thousands of Idahoans as "non-essential" workers, and dispatch police to businesses that reopened before he said they should. He also moved the primary election and closed down all in-person voting. Today, nearly two years later, Idaho is _still_ under an emergency declaration that Gov. Little refuses to end. We are also still dealing with mask mandates and vaccine mandates here in Idaho. When I was serving in my constitutional role as acting Governor, I issued executive orders to eliminate these mandates, but Gov. Little chose to _reimpose_ these mandates on Idahoans, and they are still infringing on individual rights even now. Mounting evidence is showing the harm masking has done to children and the CDC has even [pushed back important milestones](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=f26ae4fe44&e=823fa8e224), suggesting that the "new normal" is for children to learn to speak more slowly, a phenomenon widely blamed on kids being unable to see people's mouths when they speak. Frustration is increasing across America as mandates and emergency declarations drag on into what will soon be their third year. A growing American trucker convoy is [headed to Washington D.C.](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=7f10a6c64e&e=823fa8e224) to protest vaccine mandates and other grievances. This is an excellent opportunity for conservative Republicans to stand up and differentiate themselves from the RINOs and the leftists who embrace these liberty-destroying policies. As conservatives, we believe in personal freedom, letting individuals make their own medical choices, and not letting the federal government buy our states with its debt-financed handouts. We believe in traditional conservative values, not race-based segregation and other Marxist ideas that have made their way into our schools and universities. Our campaign to Make Idaho Free Again is all about making sure that conservative values will once again serve as our guiding principles here in Idaho. Will you take a stand _against_ the RINOs and the leftists and _for_ conservative principles by donating [**$100**](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=bf7b556bfe&e=823fa8e224), [**$50**](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=6ad8fc4e7a&e=823fa8e224), or even [**$25**](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=ce0f67d5c3&e=823fa8e224) today? It's so important that we get our message out to _every_ Idahoan so they understand what is at stake in this election. Your contribution helps us to reach more people, send more mailers, and knock on more doors. With your help, we _will_ Make Idaho Free Again!
---

I can't defend Nevada's toss-up governor seat without your help.
| | |
---
**I need your help, friend:** While Dean Heller and my other extremist Republican opponents align themselves with Donald Trump, I've spent my time as Nevada's governor working to make our state a place of opportunity for _everyone_ – from protecting voting rights to rebuilding an economy that uplifts working families.
But election experts are saying that Nevada is one of the states most likely to flip red, and both _The Cook Political Report_ and _U.S. News & World Report_ just ranked my race for governor a toss-up. That's why, with Republicans spending over _$2_ _million_ to defeat me, I'm counting on your urgent grassroots support to fight back and keep this seat blue.
**But with time running out before tonight's crucial midnight deadline, we're still falling way short of our $7,500 goal. [So I'm personally asking: Will you give $5 or more right now – split between our campaign and Jacky Rosen's – to help me defend Nevada's toss-up governor seat and keep our battleground state blue?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42153492/331856680/-1013490552?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1642-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNzIxZTlkMy1mODk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=69wT3L3iJpp4KoX__VF7HoHAudWGvYxOuiUZRk4gg4Y=)**
My core value of public service – why I ran for governor – comes from a lesson my dad used to tell me: **You need to leave your community better than you found it.**
That lesson is what drove me to work my way through college, build my own business from scratch here in Nevada, and raise my two girls as a single dad. And that lesson has been at the center of my work to build a stronger Nevada during my time as governor.
Meanwhile, the GOP has been relentlessly attempting to suppress voting rights, gut access to affordable health care and roll back reproductive freedom. Keeping my seat blue is the last line of defense against their dangerous agenda, which means the stakes of this race could not be higher.
**That's why falling short of our crucial midnight fundraising goal isn't an option. So please, friend, if you care about keeping Nevada blue and ****securing meaningful progress for working families****, will you rush $5 or more right now to help me close this gap before midnight?

Here's the best link to donate: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rosenfornevada_sisolak](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42153493/331856681/-1013490552?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1642-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNzIxZTlkMy1mODk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=69wT3L3iJpp4KoX__VF7HoHAudWGvYxOuiUZRk4gg4Y=)**
Thank you so much for stepping up in such a crucial moment.

Steve

name: Malik Hubbard, Team ODP
subject: Celebrating Ohio's Black leaders
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Ohio Democratic Party and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
| Hello,

This month is a time to celebrate Black History makers and those who are fighting for us today. Like Representatives Joyce Beatty and Shontel Brown who are working to make our country more equitable by giving a voice to Black Ohioans every day. And Secretary Marcia Fudge who leads the Department of Housing and Urban Development.

Their leadership is an inspiration to the next generation of Black leaders who will one day continue the fight for equality. **They remind us that change-makers aren't just a thing of the past. We're lucky enough to see them make history today.**

And we need their advocacy -- to make our country a safer, more equitable place for all. To fight for the right to vote. To fight for access to quality healthcare. And to fight for our future.

I'm so thankful we have strong leaders like Joyce Beatty and Shontel Brown fighting for Ohioans in Congress. I'm grateful that Secretary Fudge is leading the Department of Housing and Urban Development to erase barriers in our communities.

This month, while we remember how far our country has come and celebrate Black History, we also give thanks to the current Black leaders in our state. There's so much more to do to end systemic racism, and I'm so thankful they're in this fight with us.

Thank you,

clean_body: | Hello, This month is a time to celebrate Black History makers and those who are fighting for us today. Like Representatives Joyce Beatty and Shontel Brown who are working to make our country more equitable by giving a voice to Black Ohioans every day. And Secretary Marcia Fudge who leads the Department of Housing and Urban Development. Their leadership is an inspiration to the next generation of Black leaders who will one day continue the fight for equality. They remind us that change-makers aren't just a thing of the past. We're lucky enough to see them make history today. And we need their advocacy -- to make our country a safer, more equitable place for all. To fight for the right to vote. To fight for access to quality healthcare. And to fight for our future. I'm so thankful we have strong leaders like Joyce Beatty and Shontel Brown fighting for Ohioans in Congress. I'm grateful that Secretary Fudge is leading the Department of Housing and Urban Development to erase barriers in our communities. This month, while we remember how far our country has come and celebrate Black History, we also give thanks to the current Black leaders in our state. There's so much more to do to end systemic racism, and I'm so thankful they're in this fight with us. Thank you, Malik Malik Hubbard Interim Executive Director Ohio Democratic Party | Paid for by the Ohio Democratic Party and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. We are 77 days out from the Primary Election and our campaign team is working hard to earn your vote. Senator Lindstrom covered major ground this weekend meeting with the great people of Nebraska. _**Take a look at some of our campaign highlights from the past week:**_

|

|

On Saturday, Senator Lindstrom hit the campaign trail bright and early to meet with Nebraskans in the panhandle. We hosted meet and greets in Kimball, Sidney, Ogallala, Imperial and Benkelman. The hard work didn't stop there! Senator Lindstrom dropped off a 4x8 to one of our incredible #TeamLindstrom supporters in Hayes County to finish the day.

We continued our meet and greets through Sunday -- making campaign stops in Alma and Central City. On Monday, Senator Lindstrom and Dave Rippe met with young professionals in Hastings. Our children should want to grow, work and stay here and it's one of the reasons Brett and Dave are running for Governor and Lt. Governor.

body:
| | |
---
| | | “California is in dire need of an Attorney General that understands how to protect Californians’ safety and security. The soft on crime approach coming from the current Attorney General sets a dangerous precedent, and as the Sheriff of Orange County, I have seen firsthand how these policies have endangered our local communities. Nathan Hochman has the leadership and experience that is needed to bring this state’s law enforcement policies back on track. His many years at the Department of Justice, tough on crime and pragmatic approach, and support for victims’ rights have prepared him to take on the responsibilities of being our state’s top law enforcement officer. Nathan is the right person at the right time with the right policies and has my full and complete endorsement for California Attorney General.” **-Orange County Sheriff Don Barnes**
---
| Welcome to the team, Sheriff Barnes!

Sheriff Barnes has been the epitome of professionalism and integrity in law enforcement, with a distinguished career serving the 3.2 million Californians that call Orange County home.

Over his 20+ years with the Orange County Sheriff's Department, Sheriff Barnes's hard work and dedication to law and order has been second to none.
---
|
---
| As your next Attorney General, I am committed to working collaboratively with law enforcement to provide them with the funding, tools, and support they need to do their jobs well.

Unlike the current Attorney General, I will enforce the law and ensure that District Attorneys do the same. I will not stand for the zero-bail and catch-and-release policies that have left law enforcement across the state in the precarious position of pursuing and apprehending criminals that should never have been on the streets in the first place.

The majority of Californians agree and our campaign continues to grow each and every day. I hope you will join us!

Sincerely,

Nathan Hochman
_Candidate for California Attorney General_

Hi friends, I have been pastoring for 50 years and I know authenticity, empathy and compassion when I see it. **Ever since I first met Doug Gansler 25 years ago, I knew that he was called to serve.** The first time that I met him, at the People's Community Baptist Church in Silver Spring in the late 1990's, I was struck by his passion and commitment to diversity and fairness in our criminal justice system. He always kept his word and transformed the Montgomery County State's Attorney's Office from the 'good old boys' to an office brimming with prosecutors who were African-American, Latino, Asian-American and women. In fact, Doug was awarded the MLK Dreamkeeper's Award for his demonstrated commitment to diversity. **And that is why I am endorsing Doug to be our next Governor of Maryland.**
---
| [ ](https://u1584542.ct.sendgrid.net/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnlYEBRuv3LZltPZnpT13Z_ZvnJe4nH_WOjWTJhkaafbze_OQBn00CCxOO9n6Sli2XNomqIGV3_HW2WCF2mq7x9dVpm0_xg-GwqvBgsOpxDXhGs0r-AHKZ5sBDmmnKml6QZgc7tUFj2JaaLQMG5pqXC4Fx75Mi8T0lX2Gr6g815LJ7V2WtaTzoxNLDDQ3605WT0ZA7KlXRGMQ6t3QZSqJrJuzZAYFOZZGFaGcwE9tioy8R6QaYR9UwueVUTiC9ypcGY/3jt/owuAYfQJRqGvVdMRQ2xsMg/h1/UpG858CBG3H4Ec_7UaUhC8q2BCSCrzpK5HhEKID_Flg)

---
In Doug's _Sunlight of Opportunity_ plan, he outlines his commitment to the congregants of People's and our majority-minority County. He pledges to keep our families safe through instituting drug courts, domestic violence courts, and family justice centers throughout Maryland, as he did in Montgomery County. Doug will stand up for minority-owned businesses by ensuring that they have a prominent seat at the table when it comes to state procurement contracts. For all these reasons and more, I believe Doug is the best suited candidate to make Maryland a more safe, just, and strong place for all. **[Join me and become a community endorser today so that Doug has the support to take his campaign all the way.](https://u1584542.ct.sendgrid.net/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnlYEBRuv3LZltPZnpT13Z_ZvnJe4nH_WOjWTJhkaafbze_OQBn00CCxOO9n6Sli2XOm6-4FLfQNFlV0935oKe8E1PkZq-Lwasut-Nyeyof6VX-AkXsJ9WKPCnKKeaoGHkRUKZ3oZXwLJ-dsP26iTyISMkILQ7RR7ElpV_yRSSipk2h8l2aSFlp5qXVH5aY4VloGfkuZkAh0PQu8WOcPDLmOboEqrCG_HCJ8kPkJ8howM9oFVNgVrj0px5EMWJlwSfA/3jt/owuAYfQJRqGvVdMRQ2xsMg/h2/b19Nzm4mAlDoTXJ0lZzmNbVmNeK11vbFx0FHyTXbmF4)**

Why are we allowing it across the border?
Peter, did you hear the latest testimony from the Border Patrol’s Union President? If not, you NEED to read this.

To begin, we want to address the fact that for many Americans, hearing about violence at the border is difficult to relate to because the media portrays them as isolated incidents and frankly, many of us are so far removed from the violence that it’s easy to write off but this testimony changes that.

He testified that cartels are opening fire on Border Patrol Agents and according to him, the cartels now have more control over the border than our Border Patrol does.

**He also warns that the cartel’s span of control and the violence that they bring with them is moving North every day while we continue to ignore the issue.**

When asked “are Americans in danger as a result of the open borders?” The Union President answered, yes. In the last calendar year, we lost over 100,000 Americans to fentanyl **making it the leading cause of death for young people, 18-45 years of age.** Fentanyl was the cartel’s leading import across our Southern Border.

The time of this being a distant issue has passed. Cartel fentanyl is killing young people in almost every town in America, so why aren’t we aggressively addressing the problem at our border? #### Announcement

>From the Desk of Haneefah Khaaliq
# Dear Hoosiers,
In 2020, I began my humble campaign for U.S. Senate in Indiana. People thought I was crazy for starting out so early, but I knew I needed to get a head start on building my message and my mission. I'm a longtime community volunteer and former public school teacher who decided to return to school to become a lawyer. I'm an advocate and activist for human rights and civil rights. My top three issues are education, human rights, and the elimination of poverty. For the past two years, I've been to over 70 Indiana counties and held nearly 40 town halls spreading a message of hope.

I'm running for U.S. Senate in Indiana because Indiana needs someone who can make a difference and I'm not taking no for an answer. Hoosiers need someone strong who can carry the torch all the way to victory!

**Now, here's what I need you to do: **
* **Visit[haneefahkhaaliq.org](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=afad1d378e&e=a49cb82bb3) and check out my [33 national policies and agendas](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=58e1719627&e=a49cb82bb3). **
* **Forward this message to nine (9) of your friends! Why 9? Because I intend to represent all nine (9) Indiana congressional districts in the U.S. Senate. **
* **[Donate your first $9 or more](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=95bde6b695&e=a49cb82bb3)!**
* **Check your voter registration[here](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=843e976f34&e=a49cb82bb3) and get ready to #VOTEHK! **

I am Indiana! You are Indiana! Together, we are Indiana! Let's do this!

Sincerely,
Haneefah Khaaliq, Esq.
Indiana Candidate for U.S. Senate
2022

clean_body: But this isn’t the end of the fight. | | | Some good news, friend: Earlier this week, a federal court upheld the decision to block the South Carolina GOP’s six-week abortion ban. This is welcome relief in the face of attack after attack on the pregnant peoples’ right to make healthcare decisions about their own bodies. But this isn’t the end of the fight. Henry McMaster’s administration has already spent nearly $200k to defend the restrictive abortion ban in courts, and the Governor is willing to take this all the way to the Supreme Court if he has to. South Carolinians deserve to make their own reproductive healthcare decisions without interference — and they deserve a governor who’s willing to fight for this right and more. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | I’ve said it before and I’ll say it again: Reproductive healthcare decisions belong between patients and their doctors, not politicians. name: Juan Rodriguez
subject: Laying the groundwork now
body:
Peter, in case you haven’t seen any email from me, my name is Juan and I’m John’s campaign manager.

I wanted to reach out because I am so excited about everything we’ve been doing to get John elected. The work we do now, during early voting and in the time leading up to the general election, is paving the way for us to have a big win down the road.

We are counting on your support to make that happen — can you chip in now to send John to Washington? It’s past time that Texans had a representative who works for us, instead of for corporations and special interests! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lira-em-20220223?refcode=em20220223]

Donate » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lira-em-20220223?refcode=em20220223]

Right now, our team is hard at work on the ground — talking to and meeting voters about John and his vision for a future that includes all Texas — to make sure that we are putting John’s campaign in the best position possible as we start to progress further into this race.

Putting in this kind of time and work at this point in the race is an investment. It’s an investment in this campaign and it’s an investment towards getting a representative into office for TX-23 who has what it takes to fight for change.

John is no stranger to hard fights — he was a Marine, and he has been fighting for change as a public servant for the past 20 years. This race is not going to be an easy fight, especially once we are through the primary. But everything we are doing now helps strengthen our position in the fight for this seat.

Peter, this movement has been built by the people and for the people so it's what we do now — together — that will set us up for success. We have our work cut out for us and we need to strengthen our campaign now to make sure we can continue to build on the foundation we have been working on.

I firmly believe we can elect a fighter for the people who will work hard to provide a better future for Texas. Make a donation right now to invest in John’s campaign and set us up for success as we move forward. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/lira-em-20220223?refcode=em20220223]

Let’s get to work,
Juan Rodriguez

Here’s the bottom line: the plan would raise taxes on our families, cut jobs, and take away our health care.
This is exactly why we MUST flip North Carolina this fall and make sure Republicans do not take back the Senate.

Hello,
Healthcare should be a right; not a privilege.
As a three-star admiral in the United States Navy, I received excellent healthcare – and still do – but it wasn’t because I wore stars on my collar. The most junior person under my command received the same quality care as me. I didn’t have to ‘see to that.’ The medical care system was designed to provide a high standard for everyone.
The same holds true for Iowans. They deserve a healthcare system designed to provide quality, affordable healthcare – for everyone.
Our current healthcare system is staffed by the world’s best health care providers, the best equipment, the best facilities... but it too often puts profits over people. It’s inordinately hard to navigate and far too expensive.

My opponent, Republican Senator Chuck Grassley, blocks the vote to even let Medicare negotiate drug prices. We all know why! Even some Democrats take money from Big Pharma’s corporate PACs. But not me. I’m running a campaign funded entirely by grassroots donors like you.

| | Peter, Since President Biden took office, one of our top priorities has been expanding affordable health care. His Build Back Better framework has plans to do just that, but it’s currently stalled in the Senate, where conservative Democrat Joe Manchin keeps throwing cold water on policies that are very popular with the American people — and needed urgently! Americans nationwide are suffering under rising health care costs, and it is important we continue fighting in Congress to pass much-needed health care legislation. That’s why I was one of the outspoken voices from the Progressive Caucus demanding we pass Build Back Better. [_**If you agree it’s time for Congress to act, add your name to our petition right away.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42147010/331825300/206510772?refcode=em_202202023_p_a_aca&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTM3OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZjU0ODVmMy1kYjk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kvdY1S6qqHOLMYvOs4AhOiYjqTfFID_APdfOdHVYhNA=&emci=6caaa942-c194-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=0f5485f3-db94-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=22034926) Peter, President Biden’s Build Back Better framework calls for the biggest expansion of affordable health care since the Affordable Care Act was passed over a decade ago, strengthening the original legislation and reducing the premiums for 9 million Americans all across the country. It would also reduce prescription drug costs, close the Medicaid coverage gap for 4 million more Americans, and expand Medicare to cover hearing benefits. Like so many of you, I’ve fought insurance companies over the jaw-dropping cost of life-saving prescription medications. I’m a two-time cancer survivor and the dad of two sons with Crohn’s disease. At times, managing all of our care felt like another part-time job, even with good insurance coverage. And throughout my time as a union organizer, we took on tough fights against the largest health care corporations of the time. That work showed me how society can change when working people stick together. It is crucial we make headway in this fight, be it through Build Back Better, Medicare for All, or any other policy that makes the necessary investments in the type of quality care all Americans deserve. But every passing day represents a missed opportunity to make that goal a reality, and we can’t keep waiting any longer. [_**Join me and this grassroots movement and sign your name to let my Senate colleagues know you agree we need to take action on health care, and we need to do it right away.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42147011/331825301/206510772?refcode=em_202202023_p_a_aca&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTM3OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZjU0ODVmMy1kYjk0LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kvdY1S6qqHOLMYvOs4AhOiYjqTfFID_APdfOdHVYhNA=&emci=6caaa942-c194-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=0f5485f3-db94-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=22034926) Let’s go!

Americans nationwide are suffering under rising health care costs, and it is important we continue fighting in Congress to pass much-needed health care legislation. That’s why I was one of the outspoken voices from the Progressive Caucus demanding we pass Build Back Better. Peter, President Biden’s Build Back Better framework calls for the biggest expansion of affordable health care since the Affordable Care Act was passed over a decade ago, strengthening the original legislation and reducing the premiums for 9 million Americans all across the country. It would also reduce prescription drug costs, close the Medicaid coverage gap for 4 million more Americans, and expand Medicare to cover hearing benefits. Like so many of you, I’ve fought insurance companies over the jaw-dropping cost of life-saving prescription medications. I’m a two-time cancer survivor and the dad of two sons with Crohn’s disease. At times, managing all of our care felt like another part-time job, even with good insurance coverage. And throughout my time as a union organizer, we took on tough fights against the largest health care corporations of the time. That work showed me how society can change when working people stick together. body:

When Martin Luther King Jr. imagined a country where people “will not be judged by the color of their skin but by the content of their character,” he forged a bold, new vision for America.

But now, the radical Left wants to separate us by race and pit children against each other over the color of their skin.

**No government policy should benefit one citizen over another because of their race. It’s time to eliminate racial politics in America.**

I put together an 11 point plan to **Rescue America** , and one of my _top priorities_ is to STOP the Democrats’ racial division.

Friend,

**_What do Illinois sheriffs think about our crime crisis?_**

body:
Everyone in PA should have broadband access.
#
We’ll keep this quick, Derek --
**In today’s society, access to broadband internet is as important as access to electricity. ⚡**
Yet, millions across PA aren’t able to attend virtual classes, work remotely, or virtually connect with loved ones. This inequity in broadband access is not sustainable for working families.
**[Will you sign our petition to tell Congress to fund universal broadband access? It's time to make sure everyone has the ability to get online.](https://act.johnfetterman.com/sign/jf-email-broadband/?source=em20220223-4707&t=1&akid=4707%2E434096%2Eyj1y3T)**
**[Add Your Name →](https://act.johnfetterman.com/sign/jf-email-broadband/?source=em20220223-4707&t=2&akid=4707%2E434096%2Eyj1y3T)**
Thank you for your support on this important issue.
—Fetterman HQ
_\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: JohnFetterman.com
Date: Sun, Feb 20, 2022
Subject: Going big on broadband
To: Derek [dpwillis67@gmail.com]_
When John was in Smethport, PA last weekend, a member of the crowd shared that people park outside of the local library just to use the internet, because they can’t get it anywhere else.
**That’s unacceptable, Derek.**
In Pennsylvania, and across the country, from cities to rural areas, everyone should have access to stable high-speed Internet from home.
If you agree that everyone should be able to use the many services afforded by Internet access, like seeing doctors via telehealth, applying to jobs, and accessing online school, [**_will you add your name to John’s new petition to tell Congress to fund universal broadband access once and for all?_**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/sign/jf-email-broadband/?source=em20220223-4707&t=3&akid=4707%2E434096%2Eyj1y3T)
**[Sign Now →](https://act.johnfetterman.com/sign/jf-email-broadband/?source=em20220223-4707&t=4&akid=4707%2E434096%2Eyj1y3T)**
When millions of students and workers went virtual during the Covid-19 pandemic, it showed beyond a doubt that Internet access is not a “nice-to-have”. It’s a need-to-have. __
If John were in the Senate representing Pennsylvania right now, you can bet that he'd be pushing his colleagues in Congress to fund and deploy universal broadband access. But working families can't afford to wait any longer.
**So we’re asking you to take action today:[_Tell Congress to fund universal broadband access. It's time to make sure everyone has the ability to get online._](https://act.johnfetterman.com/sign/jf-email-broadband/?source=em20220223-4707&t=5&akid=4707%2E434096%2Eyj1y3T)**
**[Sign Now →](https://act.johnfetterman.com/sign/jf-email-broadband/?source=em20220223-4707&t=6&akid=4707%2E434096%2Eyj1y3T)**
Thank you for signing on, ✊
Team Fetterman

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20220223-4707-footer&t=7&refcode2=4707_434096_yj1y3T&akid=4707%2E434096%2Eyj1y3T)**

# Bill McSwain Releases Latest Ad
_The "Law and Order Candidate" for Governor_
**West Chester, Pa.** **\-- **Bill McSwain, Republican candidate for Governor, today released the latest in a series of television ads aimed at sharing his message of safety, security, and prosperity with voters across the Commonwealth.

The ad, titled "Bill McSwain-The Law and Order Candidate" highlights McSwain's record as U.S. Attorney appointed by President Trump, including putting rioters and looters in jail, prosecuting perpetrators of election fraud, and taking down corrupt public officials.
---
| [ ](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=fc8dbfb7a8&e=b1ec95759b)
---
| The 30-second ad is airing across the Commonwealth on Fox News, and is complemented by a [60-second version](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=1456423e6b&e=b1ec95759b) which is live on broadcast.

This is the [second ad](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=358e89369a&e=b1ec95759b) to air as part of a multi-million dollar voter outreach strategy executed in collaboration with Commonwealth Partners Chamber of Entrepreneurs' associated PACs. In addition to $6.8M spent on cable and broadcast ads alone, McSwain plans to expand his digital, direct mail, and radio presence through the May 17 primary.
---
|
---
| **BACKGROUND: **
Appointed by President Trump, McSwain's record as US Attorney demonstrates his fierce defense of constitutional rights, dedication to upholding law and order, and history of putting criminals and corrupt politicians in jail. Prior to becoming an attorney, Bill served as a scout/sniper platoon commander in the U.S. Marine Corps. He was born in Philadelphia and raised in Chester County, where he lives today with his wife, Stephanie, and their four children. More information on McSwain's background and platform is available [here.](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=a83ccd98c7&e=b1ec95759b)

Friend,

In a moment, I'm going to ask you to support our people-powered campaign to keep Georgia blue and help Democrats hold the Senate. **But first, I want to explain why your support is so important -- and what could happen without it.**

My Senate seat is one of Republicans’ biggest targets, and my opponent already has the full support of Donald Trump, Mitch McConnell, and their dark-money allies. **_And with CNN ranking mine as the most likely Democratic seat to flip, we’re depending on this grassroots team more than ever._**
