name: Angel Montalvo
subject: Angel Montalvo - Rising Tide Newsletter 02/23/2022
body:
Friend,

The end of February is here. We’re 6 months out from our primary (August 23rd).

We’re proud to be leading as the only Democratic Party candidate in the primary and one thing is very clear, our message is resonating.
People understand that it’s the corrupt and out of touch politicians who are devastating our communities. Unlike corporate politicians, we center our platform on the working people of our community. If we put the work in and talk to our community about policies like Medicare for All and Climate Justice we will win.

This past Saturday our campaign officially launched! We heard inspiring messages from community members as we reflected on our collective and common struggles. Our new shirts, signs, buttons, and stickers as showcased above were sold. Keep an eye out for our upcoming online store!

We’re geared up to start our community outreach. Thank you so much for your presence and support, this would be impossible without you. If you couldn’t make it out there’s more to come!

Be sure to join our volunteer WhatsApp group chat with this link:
<https://chat.whatsapp.com/IpHvfWgR9dR7szE2DufcwV>

UPCOMING EVENTS

Join us for our first canvass launch of 2022! We’re having a canvass launch Saturday, Feb. 26, 2022 @ 12:00 PM ET at William H. Kerdyk, Jr., and Family Park in Coral Gables!

The strength of our campaign comes from the real people who support our campaign, not corporate money. To get on the ballot in Florida we can either get 2,568 petitions signed or pay $10,000.

It’s clear why our government is so corrupt and morally bankrupt. When only the ruling class can afford to run, only the ruling class is represented while our communities get left behind.

Our goal is to collect 10,000 petitions. We’ll match every dollar with a person who agrees that it’s time for our government to work for the people of our country, not just a privileged few.

We can only do this with your help. Join us.

#NotMeUS #MontalvoforMiami

CURRENT EVENTS

The Florida Senate has silently passed an abortion bill that if ratified would limit access to safe abortions. HB 5, which cleared the Florida house last week, was approved 13-6 by the Senate Appropriations Committee on Monday and is expected to head to the Senate floor next week.

Another seismic bill up for consideration is SB 1834 coined the ‘Don’t Say Gay’ bill which restricts teachers and school administration from mentioning LGBTQ issues in schools. The bill — backed[ Gov. Ron DeSantis](https://www.nbcnews.com/nbc-out/out-politics-and-policy/florida-gov-ron-desantis-signals-support-dont-say-gay-bill-rcna15326) — would allow districts and educators to out their students to their parents, unless they felt doing so would result in "abuse, abandonment or neglect.” The proposed legislation would also bar educators from teaching about sexual orientation or gender identity between kindergarten and third grade, or “in a manner that is not age-appropriate or developmentally appropriate.” ([Ja'han Jones](https://www.msnbc.com/author/ja-jones-ncpn371241))

IMPORTANT LINKS
Contribute Today: [https://bit.ly/ContributeMontalvo4Congress](https://bit.ly/ContributeMontalvo4Congress)
Website: [https://www.montalvoforcongress.com/](https://www.montalvoforcongress.com/)
Instagram: [https://bit.ly/3BIgS5S](https://bit.ly/3BIgS5S)
Facebook: [https://www.facebook.com/MontalvoForCongress
](https://www.facebook.com/MontalvoForCongress)Volunteer WhatsApp group chat: <https://chat.whatsapp.com/IpHvfWgR9dR7szE2DufcwV>

[**We need Tyler Kistner in Congress.**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=71bb087cdb1e4506a86fc33421d2dad7&_e=3gG5m7YfxA8NDBSPDKyRmc2DYQv7Uk-X558hFifaByj9NaZ8QW9ENqWx4HPdqS9Lsl9C5Z4VyW9xIZw-Fo2rqUMz13PfvxIINsT3ZJ-vMkbX0wkWHVeV_JiO6OHimMibFeQ36_BMph8s2uNKYZSJaybPRWcn8dYznFSFsZNNAXqEj9FNa2VWtJ0RPYmOpuuW4xXnKva3Y3FU98LigepLPniD5JTLdjxl1mGaQRo4SuH3Z0zoZf2iLZ0daoGtT6DokAF5famGpgsm5ntsurPrDWcnkd2QTZ2ubVB0APJthUAJMfq03vIa4cVYa9GAmBmOcvLW4OFYfXxBUgwJs098pIouwRd9cul8AQk7cXTkVooBEIe4HIWTPRjtDRBpTyMISMETeYtZ0Y7MQJwD3sOc-20br_zdJKZ_UCnXk6jorSXIc0jk0JzxQt-wfV-wlux73AoIzOwr002uTL-3eNbHYg%3D%3D)

Tyler served on four overseas tours and advanced rapidly to command over 500 U.S. and partner nation personnel on numerous counterterrorism and counter China/Russia aggression operations. During his active service, Tyler had command and control of Special Operations programs totaling over $100 million in budget and assets.

After coming home, Tyler transitioned to the Marine reserves so he could focus on his family. But Fellow American, that’s when he became so concerned about the future direction of our country and decided --_for his children’s sake_ -- that he could no longer sit on the sidelines.

body:
| [ ](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=Bjc8XUdeJ9yV6eR3mI9Z6HRd5urWv8u8i-Pa-jQziook9GM6ZCJmtpUFYCf-NUON&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=feb23_donor_final&n=1)
---
Hi Peter, As a loyal subscriber, you know I like to keep my emails succinct, substantive, and action-oriented. I only directly ask for your support when it’s most important. Right now, it’s as important as ever. [Here is the link](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=09K6E4GvoPozZ73mzf50y5etLj1_9wCfyRoQ3wvVmv-GOhHPWzgYbh54Gph7Pyuk3g2mp41Qa8XyLKk0CnWqFcPhfo-70bh2d9FGRmWv-G0iUqqLQazIF6cOfkGWrQv5&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=feb23_donor_final&n=2) to donate, but I want to say a few words about why it’s so important now. There are two reasons. First, the end of February is near. We have done well this month, but we haven’t quite kept pace with our strong January numbers. That’s mainly because I’ve been so busy at the Capitol – fighting to end the State of Emergency, repeal Prop. 47, and suspend the gas tax – that I haven’t had as much time for the campaign. The good news is February is not yet over. [We still have time](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=09K6E4GvoPozZ73mzf50y5etLj1_9wCfyRoQ3wvVmv-GOhHPWzgYbh54Gph7Pyuk3g2mp41Qa8XyLKk0CnWqFcPhfo-70bh2d9FGRmWv-G0iUqqLQazIF6cOfkGWrQv5&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=feb23_donor_final&n=3). The second reason your support is so important now is that we're very close to the last day for other candidates to file to run. If our opponents sense any weakness, they'll do anything and everything to defeat us. Those opponents are Newsom, Pelosi, and the far-leftists, yes. But truthfully, my most vicious antagonists have been the swamp creatures in either party who live _off_ politics rather than living _for_ public service. The thing they fear most is an elected official who isn’t owned by anyone. That’s why they see our movement as so deeply threatening. And it’s why [I need your help to fight back](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=09K6E4GvoPozZ73mzf50y5etLj1_9wCfyRoQ3wvVmv-GOhHPWzgYbh54Gph7Pyuk3g2mp41Qa8XyLKk0CnWqFcPhfo-70bh2d9FGRmWv-G0iUqqLQazIF6cOfkGWrQv5&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=feb23_donor_final&n=4). Before I decided my plans for this year, I sent an email asking for your advice. 3,000 people responded. The overriding sentiment was to run for Congress because we simply can’t allow our country to go down the same disastrous path as California. I entered the race so I could fight Biden and Pelosi’s radical agenda just as hard as I’ve fought Newsom and the Supermajority. And I entered knowing it was a risk. Reelection to the Assembly was all but assured. In seeking national office, I knew I’d be targeted in ways like never before. In fact, the ugliness coming our way is even worse than I expected. We are in a fierce, high-stakes battle. But it’s one I am fighting with armor – your support. If every person who receives this message gives what you can – [whether that’s $10, $100, $500, $1000, or the legal maximum of $5,800](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=09K6E4GvoPozZ73mzf50y5etLj1_9wCfyRoQ3wvVmv-GOhHPWzgYbh54Gph7Pyuk3g2mp41Qa8XyLKk0CnWqFcPhfo-70bh2d9FGRmWv-G0iUqqLQazIF6cOfkGWrQv5&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=feb23_donor_final&n=5) – that armor will be so strong that no opponent can break through. Every night, no matter how late I get home from the Capitol or campaign, I sign Thank You letters to each of my supporters. I feel a special bond with every person who makes it possible to fight for our state and country. If you have already supported my campaign for Congress, thank you so much. If you can, I’d be incredibly grateful if you can [take that support to the next level](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=09K6E4GvoPozZ73mzf50y5etLj1_9wCfyRoQ3wvVmv-GOhHPWzgYbh54Gph7Pyuk3g2mp41Qa8XyLKk0CnWqFcPhfo-70bh2d9FGRmWv-G0iUqqLQazIF6cOfkGWrQv5&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=feb23_donor_final&n=6). If you have not yet had the chance to contribute, I would love nothing more than to have you on our team of citizen-supporters. With gratitude and humility, Kevin p.s. It’s hard to believe how close the election is. Ballots go out in 71 days. [Whatever you can give](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=09K6E4GvoPozZ73mzf50y5etLj1_9wCfyRoQ3wvVmv-GOhHPWzgYbh54Gph7Pyuk3g2mp41Qa8XyLKk0CnWqFcPhfo-70bh2d9FGRmWv-G0iUqqLQazIF6cOfkGWrQv5&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=feb23_donor_final&n=7) will help us win.

Why are we allowing it across the border?
Fellow American, did you hear the latest testimony from the Border Patrol’s Union President? If not, you NEED to read this.

To begin, we want to address the fact that for many Americans, hearing about violence at the border is difficult to relate to because the media portrays them as isolated incidents and frankly, many of us are so far removed from the violence that it’s easy to write off but this testimony changes that.

He testified that cartels are opening fire on Border Patrol Agents and according to him, the cartels now have more control over the border than our Border Patrol does.

**He also warns that the cartel’s span of control and the violence that they bring with them is moving North every day while we continue to ignore the issue.**

When asked “are Americans in danger as a result of the open borders?” The Union President answered, yes. In the last calendar year, we lost over 100,000 Americans to fentanyl **making it the leading cause of death for young people, 18-45 years of age.** Fentanyl was the cartel’s leading import across our Southern Border.

The time of this being a distant issue has passed. Cartel fentanyl is killing young people in almost every town in America, so why aren’t we aggressively addressing the problem at our border? | | When I found out Forbes' named me their first-ever "[Technology Person of the Year,](https://www.rebekahjonescampaign.com/so/d3NyeZp36/c?w=mKSqfl5u6QtSE2pci513qpduZUhy9uU_ICK-u85N2iM.)" I couldn't believe it. In a year when technology defined our lives - the way we worked, the way our kids went to school, the paradigm shift in our entire culture - Forbes named me its first-ever technology person of the year! While my name holds the title two years running now, Forbes really named all of those who found it in themselves to stand up and fill the voids left by corrupt and inept government, from Florida to the Feds. That's why I founded, funded and coordinated the [2021 COVID-19 Data Hero Awards](https://www.rebekahjonescampaign.com/so/d3NyeZp36/c?w=ifvcIsWeTpBkJ6akRqtx7utEOockB8yFGwwyXp-Pl-Y.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9kYXRhaGVyb2F3YXJkcy5vcmcvIiwiciI6IjAxZjFkYzI2LTFkNjEtNDhhMC0zZTU3LWM0N2FjYzY1ZTJmNyIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjdlN2E4N2UxLTcwNDMtNDE3OS1iODM4LTVjYTg5MjBmYWFkNyJ9) \- to highlight the work and achievements of those who, like me, stepped up when everyone else was too afraid or too resource-constrained to do so. The people I have gotten to know during this journey - the healthcare workers, the information technologists, statisticians, researchers, doctors, and more - exemplify the human capacity for innovation in a time of crisis. Having the endorsement of multiple Nobel Prize nominees, major medical organizations, academic organizations, activists, technologists, and of course the backbone of America - workers - means the world to me. None of it would be possible without the awards and exposure I received while fighting corruption in Florida. If you believe in our fight, donate today. Don't read or click and move on - we need everyone to chip in whatever they can to rid Congress of Matt Gaetz once and for all!

| **CONGRESSMAN BOB WALKER ENDORSES CHARLIE GEROW FOR GOVERNOR**
"Charlie Gerow has all the qualities which should define our next Governor. He has been an inspirational political leader in the Commonwealth and the Nation. He is the embodiment of the American Dream having immigrated to this country at a young age and then used the opportunities afforded by a free people to climb the ladder of success.

"His career has included success as a businessman, a television commentator, a national conservative spokesman and an articulate voice for our values and our hopes. He speaks truth to the powerful and embodies the belief that leaders should seek to unite rather than divide.

"During my 20 years serving our Commonwealth in the Congress, I found that if you want to bring about positive change it begins with listening to the people you serve and using the office they have entrusted to you to make their lives better. I trust Charlie Gerow to be that kind of Governor."

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Corporate Democrats are blaming “Squad politics” for the Democratic
Party’s lower midterm poll numbers. But if the establishment followed
Squad politics, the Democratic Party would actually be delivering for the
people.

Squad politics are passing Build Back Better and fighting for Medicare for
All, a Green New Deal, racial justice, codifying Roe v. Wade, canceling
student debt, raising the minimum wage to at least $15, reducing child
poverty, and so much more. Squad politics are doing what’s right for the
people.

That’s why AOC, Ilhan, Rashida, Cori, Jamaal, and Ayanna were some of the
only House Democrats to vote to protect President Biden’s agenda to fight
climate change, extend the Child Tax Credit, lower health care costs, and
secure paid family and medical leave. Now, because of the Democratic
Party’s inability to deliver, child poverty rose 41% after the Child Tax
Credit wasn’t renewed.

Corporate Democrats are always blaming progressives for their own
failures. Justice Democrats is one of the few groups investing in electing
progressive fighters and defeating establishment politicians looking for
scapegoats rather than economic, social, racial, and environmental
justice.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/95836?refcode=em20220223-22119&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=22119%2E1203867%2ERvhMKw ]Can you chip in $3 to help us expand the Squad in
Congress and advocate for even more people-centered politics?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/95836?refcode=em20220223-22119&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=22119%2E1203867%2ERvhMKw ]Contribute

When Democrats lose, they blame progressives in their quest for power with
no questions asked. They did it when the House majority shrunk after the
2020 election and when centrists lost the Virginia governor’s race last
year. And they’re doing it again as Democrats see their polling numbers
slip ahead of the midterm elections in November.

When Democrats fail to deliver, they want to find excuses to blame the
Squad. If corporate Democrats listened less to their corporate donors, and
fought for the people, they’d be creating jobs, protecting the planet, and
improving life for nearly every person in this country.

The smears from the Democratic establishment AND the extreme right-wing
GOP will continue, because representatives like AOC, Cori Bush, and Ilhan
Omar threaten the power of both parties.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/95836?refcode=em20220223-22119&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=22119%2E1203867%2ERvhMKw ]We need to show that we won’t back off our Squad
politics,
Peter. Can you rush a
$3 donation to Justice Democrats to show our power? This is
part of our response to smears from the Democratic establishment.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1023&akid=22119%2E1203867%2ERvhMKw ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the

Okay, folks, I’m not trying to gas myself up here, but let’s keep it real: **I’m the only true progressive in this race, and I always have been.**

Recently, my opponents have tried to claim that we don’t need bold, progressive policies — yet when it comes to scoring political points, they have no problem tossing around phrases like “accessible healthcare”, “climate action”, “working families” and more — all without any distinct plans to lift these causes up.

**_So before you let their buzzwords fool you, here’s the truth:_**

You say you care about accessible healthcare,
But you’re too scared to say **Medicare For All.**

You say you care about climate action and green solutions,
But you’re too scared to say a **Green New Deal.**

You say you care about working families,
But you gladly accept **corporate PAC money.**

You say you care about our future generations,
But you’re too scared to say **Cancel ALL Student Loan Debt.**

**_I’m sensing a pattern here, and it’s all too familiar._** Corporate-backed establishment politicians in the running with empty promises of a “brighter future” in order to sweet talk voters into electing them — only to make it to office and water down practical and bold solutions that would actually lift up working-class people.

Since entering this race about a year ago, I’ve never been wishy washy or unclear about where I stand on these critical issues that impact so many daily lives in TX-30. I haven’t been afraid to champion “daring” policies and challenge the status quo.

Because having lived through so many of the real-life struggles our Dallas families face, is what gives me courage, strength, and motivation to fight fearlessly for the people and communities I love. **And I refuse to back down or soften my demands until working-class people see the progress we deserve.**

Recently, my opponents have tried to claim that we don’t need bold, progressive policies — yet when it comes to scoring political points, they have no problem tossing around phrases like “accessible healthcare”, “climate action”, “working families” and more — all without any distinct plans to lift these causes up. So before you let their buzzwords fool you, here’s the truth: You say you care about accessible healthcare, But you’re too scared to say Medicare For All. You say you care about climate action and green solutions, But you’re too scared to say a Green New Deal. You say you care about working families, But you gladly accept corporate PAC money. You say you care about our future generations, But you’re too scared to say Cancel ALL Student Loan Debt. I’m sensing a pattern here, and it’s all too familiar. Corporate-backed establishment politicians in the running with empty promises of a “brighter future” in order to sweet talk voters into electing them — only to make it to office and water down practical and bold solutions that would actually lift up working-class people. Since entering this race about a year ago, I’ve never been wishy washy or unclear about where I stand on these critical issues that impact so many daily lives in TX-30. I haven’t been afraid to champion “daring” policies and challenge the status quo. _****_Learn More About Chuck_**

---
---
| | | Family, hard work and community. These are the things that have defined me as a person more than anything else and are the things that make New Hampshire a special place. Several local Salem community leaders became role models and mentors and got me involved with helping our community. With their encouragement, I ran for Salem Selectman and won. I ran for Town Moderator and won. Then I ran for State Representative and served for two terms from 1998-2002. I was elected to the State Senate in 2002 and was appointed to the Finance Committee. My experience running a business, meeting a payroll, and keeping a conservative budget helped prepare me for the challenges of crafting a balanced state budget. I quickly became known as one of the state’s leaders in budgeting and tax policy. I took a step back from politics in 2006. My daughter was starting her junior year in high school and Susan and I spent most of the next few years traveling to her field hockey and basketball games. We were her biggest fans. In 2010, I was reelected to the Senate. When I returned to the Finance Committee, I found the financial mess that the Democrats had put our state in. The state had an $800 million deficit. We quickly turned that around and put the state’s finances back on a sustainable path. For my work, colleagues gave me the greatest honor of my life — electing me the Senate President in 2013. In 2020, I led Republican efforts to retake the majority in the State Senate. New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. Last year, we passed one of the most conservative and fiscally responsible budgets that New Hampshire has ever seen. It is balanced, cuts taxes for small businesses, provides more than $300 million in property tax relief, bans late-term abortions, and prohibits the use of discriminatory teaching in our schools. It puts New Hampshire on a path to long-term prosperity. The work ethic, commitment to family and sense of community that I learned at a young age have stuck with me as an adult and drive everything I do. I still wake up at 4am every morning to work at our business before going to Concord to do the people’s business. More often than not, I still take my first phone calls of the day while driving a tractor. Washington, D.C. has enough silver-spoon, Ivy League lawyers. I believe that I am a product of all the best parts of New Hampshire — the spirit of freedom, sense of volunteerism and responsibility of giving back to the community that has helped shape me into the person I am today. I want to bring New Hampshire to Washington and makes sure our voices are heard. I want to bring New Hampshire values to a place that needs them now more than ever. I want to work for you and I hope you will consider electing me to represent you in the U.S. Senate.

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WILLIAM OLSON FOR CONGRESS
body:
Any amount is too much |

| Hi Peter,

As a career soldier, I saw lots of waste in the military. Some of it even became a running joke.

But what Biden and his lackey, General Milley, are doing with the woke mandates and "re-education".... is beyond words.

**My name is Bill Olson, and I am an America First Christian and combat vet [running to reclaim Florida's 9th district](https://billolsonfl.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d46f7bf5f11f241ec4a0954ff&id=93bb172d76&e=afa21b7626), a swing district south of Orlando. **

I spent decades in the military, and my sons as well. I know well that a military that is not solely focused on fighting and winning wars, won't be a military that's very good at all.

It would appear that's what we now have.
---
| [ ](https://billolsonfl.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d46f7bf5f11f241ec4a0954ff&id=84e1756941&e=afa21b7626)
---
| **FOX News has the report on how costly the military's woke agenda is- in dollars and cents. **

_The U.S. Department of Defense spent nearly 6 million man-hours on implementing President Biden’s "leftist social agenda" across the military, Republicans said Monday.

Joint Chiefs of Staff Chairman Gen. Mark Milley responded in a Jan. 6 letter to Sen. James Inhofe, R-Okla., ranking member of the Senate Armed Services Committee, following a request for data on the total number of hours and money the DOD spent on new trainings across the military regarding climate change, extremism and diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI). _

_Milley’s response, obtained by Fox New Digital, revealed that more than 5.3 million hours and $535,000 was spent on extremism "stand downs," or discussions about extremism in the ranks ordered by Secretary of Defense Lloyd J. Austin in February.

"This averages to just over 2 hours per Service member in a total force of 2.46 million members and is comparable to other Joint Force periodic training requirements," Milley wrote._

_**The letter also revealed that roughly 530,000 hours and $477,000 was spent on new DEI trainings and more than 1,000 hours and $5,000 was spent on coordinating the DOD’s Climate Adaptation Plan.**_

_Inhofe and 11 other Republicans on the Armed Services Committee issued a letter Monday accusing the DOD of targeting military members while relations with Russia and China continue to deteriorate.

"We face real threats across the world, yet the Biden administration is more focused on promoting its leftist social agenda in the military instead of countering China, Russia and Iran or creating an effective counterterrorism plan," the senators said in the letter provided to Fox News Digital. "Our military is not an extremist organization, and our service members, by and large all good people, are dedicated, faithful patriots."_

No wonder we lost Afghanistan. Look at the garbage we waste our time on!
---

**I have an idea. Let's kick this guy out of Congress and defund the woke education programs, permanently.**

[I got more votes here in 2020 than any Republican ever had, because I stand and fight the woke](https://billolsonfl.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d46f7bf5f11f241ec4a0954ff&id=edc8aa8d86&e=afa21b7626).

Help me stand up to Biden and his woke generals, and make our military great again! [Help me stop all of Biden's agenda!](https://billolsonfl.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d46f7bf5f11f241ec4a0954ff&id=cdbb8d03c0&e=afa21b7626)
